full_list.title_en: Low-Altitude Fluid Antenna Network with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Low-Altitude Fluid Antenna Network with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.27909v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Low-altitude wireless networks (LAWNs) integrate terrestrial and aerial platforms to provide ubiquitous communication, sensing, and localization services for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft. However, dynamic air-ground and air-air channels, abrupt blockages, and heterogeneous interference hinder the realization of this goal. Nevertheless, fluid antenna (FA), a cutting-edge multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) technique, overcomes these challenges by reconfiguring antenna positions to unlock additional spatial degrees-of-freedom. In this paper, towards bringing low-altitude FA networks into reality, we study the fast and high-performance FA reconfiguration for low-altitude FA networks with multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). Specifically, we present an electromagnetic digital twin (EM-DT)-assisted MARL framework. To fill the sim-to-real gap, we introduce a two-stage transfer learning framework. Our case study shows that joint FA positions and beamforming optimization can enhance the system sum-rate by 118.5%, compared to the fixed position baseline. This gain comes from the dynamic millisecond timescale reconfiguration of FA arrays and the adaptive steering of beams toward aerial users with mobility.

full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Low-Altitude Fluid Antenna Network with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Magnetoelasticity in Fe/GaAs(110) films: Depth profile of magnetic anisotropy
full_list.title_zh: Fe/GaAs(110) 薄膜中的磁弹性：磁各向异性的深度分布
full_list.abstract: Author(s): Aleksandra Lindner, Rodolfo A. Gallardo, Andreas Henschke, Fabian Ganss, Javier Pablo-Navarro, Gabriel Gray, Ruslan Salikhov, Kilian Lenz, Toni Hache, Dirk Sander, Gauravkumar Patel, Sebastian Fähler, Olav Hellwig, Jürgen Fassbender, and Jürgen Lindner The authors report here the coexistence of cubic and uniaxial magnetic anisotropies in thick epitaxial bcc Fe(110)/GaAs(110) films, with the latter having a magnitude comparable to that of the former. Their interplay stabilizes an in-plane easy axis along the ⟨001⟩ directions that persists throughout the film volume for thicknesses up to 100 nm. This unconventional behavior gives rise to a depth-dependent magnetic response, with perpendicular standing spin-wave modes exhibiting distinct sensitivities to different regions of the film thickness. The study further identifies anisotropic strain as the microscopic origin of the observed in-plane uniaxial anisotropy. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 094438] Published Mon Aug 31, 2026
full_list.abstract_zh: 研究报道了厚外延 bcc Fe(110)/GaAs(110) 薄膜中立方和单轴磁各向异性的共存，二者共同稳定了沿 ⟨001⟩ 方向的面内易轴。该非常规行为导致磁响应随薄膜深度而变化，不同垂直驻波自旋波模式对膜厚不同区域的敏感性不同。研究还确定各向异性应变是面内单轴磁各向异性的微观起源。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 作者：Aleksandra Lindner、Rodolfo A. Gallardo、Andreas Henschke、Fabian Ganss、Javier Pablo-Navarro、Gabriel Gray、Ruslan Salikhov、Kilian Lenz、Toni Hache、Dirk Sander、Gauravkumar Patel、Sebastian Fähler、Olav Hellwig、Jürgen Fassbender 和 Jürgen Lindner。作者在此报道，在厚外延 bcc Fe(110)/GaAs(110) 薄膜中，立方磁各向异性和单轴磁各向异性共存，后者的量级可与前者相当。它们之间的相互作用稳定了沿 ⟨001⟩ 方向的面内易轴，对于厚度最高达 100 nm 的薄膜，这一易轴贯穿整个膜体积而保持存在。这种非常规行为导致了随深度变化的磁响应，垂直驻波自旋波模式对薄膜厚度不同区域表现出不同的敏感性。该研究进一步确定，各向异性应变是观测到的面内单轴磁各向异性的微观起源。[《Physical Review B》114，094438]，发表于 2026 年 8 月 31 日。

full_list.title_en: Reinforcement-learning control of turbulence transition in the modified Hasegawa-Wakatani system
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Reinforcement-learning control of turbulence transition in the modified Hasegawa-Wakatani system
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.27845v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Control of plasma turbulence remains a long-standing challenge in magnetically confined fusion research. Here, we explore a reinforcement-learning (RL) approach for bidirectional control of the turbulence-zonal-flow transition in the modified Hasegawa-Wakatani system, a minimal model of electrostatic drift-wave turbulence. Within our model, a weak zonal drag damps the otherwise long-lived zonal structures, giving them a finite lifetime and restoring the drive-damping balance required for repeatable transitions within finite control episodes; meanwhile, actuation is applied through a spatially distributed Gaussian source field under a time-weighted budget constraint on actuation costs. The plasma model is then coupled to CNN-based soft actor-critic and twin-delayed deterministic policy-gradient agents through a GPU-native JAX solver that is highly optimized for fast online training. In the turbulence-suppression task, the learned budget-aware schedule achieves the lowest time-integrated turbulent flux for a given consumed budget, outperforming both constant and linearly decreasing baselines across all tested unseen initial conditions. In the inverse zonal-break task, the agent discovers an up-down antisymmetric actuation pattern that induces radial E× B convection, disrupts the zonal structure, and sustains the turbulent state. A physics-informed warm-buffer initialization facilitates this discovery, as random exploration alone struggles to locate the narrow optimal manifold within the vast action space. These results demonstrate reinforcement learning as a practical trajectory optimizer for nonlinear plasma dynamics, such as turbulence control, and highlight the importance of physics guidance in such applications.

full_list.title_en: Spin-Selective Spectral Flattening and Wave-Packet Dynamics in a Flux-Engineered Lieb Lattice
full_list.title_zh: 通量工程Lieb晶格中的自旋选择性谱平坦化与波包动力学
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.28054v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate reversible internal-state-selective wave-packet transport induced by spin-dependent Peierls phases in a two-dimensional nearest-neighbor Lieb lattice. The two conserved spin components experience effective fluxes ασ=α₀+sσαₛ, where sₚ̆ₐᵣᵣₒw,dₒwₙₐᵣᵣₒw=±1. At the working point α₀=αₛ=1/4, the spin-up and spin-down components experience αₚ̆ₐᵣᵣₒw=1/2 and αdₒwₙₐᵣᵣₒw=0, respectively. A band-resolved calculation in the q=2 magnetic unit cell shows that the spin-up spectrum contains two zero-energy flat subbands associated with the sublattice-imbalance flat-band sector, whereas the remaining four subbands retain finite bandwidths. The half-flux sector therefore fails the all-bands-flat condition and does not realize exact Aharonov--Bohm caging for a generic localized initial state. Nevertheless, real-time simulations reveal a pronounced suppression of spin-up propagation relative to the dispersive spin-down component, manifested by a smaller mean-square displacement and an enhanced finite-region retention probability over the pre-reflection time window. Reversing the state-dependent flux interchanges the slow and fast spin channels, while the dynamical contrast remains robust against moderate flux detuning. These results establish spin-dependent synthetic flux as a reversible means of controlling internal-state-resolved matter-wave transport without spin-flip processes or interactions, and provide complementary spectral and real-space criteria for distinguishing exact caging from finite-time dynamical slowing in atomic and photonic flat-band simulators.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文研究二维最近邻Lieb晶格中由自旋依赖Peierls相位引起的、可逆的内态选择性波包输运。在特定通量工作点，自旋向上分量虽含有两个零能平带子带，但其余子带仍有有限带宽，因而不能对一般局域初态实现严格的Aharonov-Bohm笼禁。实时模拟显示，自旋向上传播显著慢于色散性自旋向下分量；反转通量可交换快慢通道，且这种动力学对比对适度失谐稳健。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了二维最近邻Lieb晶格中由自旋依赖Peierls相位诱导的、可逆的内态选择性波包输运。两个守恒自旋分量经历的有效通量为ασ=α0+sσασ，其中s上、下=±1。在工作点α0=ασ=1/4时，自旋向上和自旋向下分量分别经历α上=1/2和α下=0。在q=2磁性元胞中进行的分辨能带计算表明，自旋向上谱包含两个与子晶格不平衡平带扇区相关的零能平坦子带，而其余四个子带仍保有有限带宽。因此，半通量扇区不满足所有能带均平坦的条件，也无法对一般局域初态实现精确的Aharonov-Bohm笼禁。尽管如此，实时模拟揭示出，相对于色散性的自旋向下分量，自旋向上传播受到显著抑制，表现为在反射前时间窗口内较小的均方位移和较高的有限区域滞留概率。反转态依赖通量会交换慢速与快速自旋通道，而动力学对比对于适度的通量失谐仍然稳健。这些结果确立了自旋依赖人工通量作为一种可逆手段，可在无自旋翻转过程或相互作用的条件下控制按内态分辨的物质波输运，并为在原子和光子平带模拟器中区分精确笼禁与有限时间动力学减速提供了互补的谱学和实空间判据。

full_list.title_en: Orbital-Selective Coexistence of Interlayer Spin-Singlet Formation and SDW Order with Anomalous Spin Reconfiguration in Bilayer Nickelate La₃Ni₂O₇ Revealed by ¹⁷O-NMR
full_list.title_zh: 通过17O核磁共振揭示双层镍酸盐La3Ni2O7中层间自旋单态形成与SDW有序的轨道选择性共存及异常自旋重构
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.27917v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The spin structure of the spin density wave (SDW) order in the bilayer nickelate La₃Ni₂O₇ has been investigated using site-selective ¹⁷O-NMR measurements on the inner apical O(1), outer apical O(2), and planar O(3,4) sites. Below Tₘ̊ SDW (= 150 K), the peak of all planar O(3,4) sites significantly broadens due to the emergence of a finite internal magnetic field, whereas O(2) sites remain with no (or a negligibly small) internal field. These results are consistent with commensurate SDW order with a single spin-spinless (or large-tiny spin) stripe. As for the O(1) sites that bridge the NiO₂ planes, the internal field is nearly canceled below Tₘ̊ SDW, indicating an antiparallel spin configuration between adjacent planes. However, below T_A (sim 115 K), the spectrum of the O(1) site disappears even though the in-plane SDW order remains robust, implying that the antiparallel spin configuration through the Ni--O(1)--Ni bond is not particularly stable below Tₘ̊ A, despite the expected strong interlayer spin coupling between the NiO₂ planes. Above all, we emphasize that the local spin susceptibility is extremely small at the O(2) site that has a strong covalency with the d₃z^₂₋ᵣ^₂ orbital, indicating a well-developed interlayer spin-singlet formation in the Ni-d₃z^₂₋ᵣ^₂ orbitals bridging the NiO₂ planes. These findings shed new light on the interlayer spin-singlet formation and the anomalous spin reconfiguration through the Ni--O(1)--Ni bonding orbitals connecting the NiO₂ planes, which characterize the orbital-selective nature of the bilayer nickelate La₃Ni₂O₇.
full_list.abstract_zh: 研究利用位点选择性17O核磁共振考察双层镍酸盐La3Ni2O7中自旋密度波（SDW）有序的自旋结构。结果表明，面内氧位点的内磁场支持具有单条无自旋或微弱自旋条纹的公度SDW有序，而连接两层NiO2平面的内顶位氧显示相邻平面自旋反平行，但该构型在约115 K以下发生异常重构。外顶位氧极低的局域自旋磁化率表明，跨层Ni-d3z2-r2轨道中已形成发达的层间自旋单态。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 研究采用对内顶位O(1)、外顶位O(2)和面内O(3,4)位点进行选择性17O核磁共振测量，考察了双层镍酸盐La3Ni2O7中自旋密度波（SDW）有序的自旋结构。在TSDW=150 K以下，所有面内O(3,4)位点的谱峰均因有限内部磁场的出现而显著展宽，而O(2)位点则没有内部磁场，或仅存在可忽略不计的内部磁场。这些结果与具有单条无自旋（或大-小自旋）条纹的公度SDW有序相一致。对于连接NiO2平面的O(1)位点，其内部磁场在TSDW以下几乎完全抵消，表明相邻平面之间存在反平行自旋构型。然而，在TA（约115 K）以下，尽管面内SDW有序仍然稳健，O(1)位点的谱线却消失了，这意味着尽管预期NiO2平面之间存在很强的层间自旋耦合，经由Ni-O(1)-Ni键的反平行自旋构型在TA以下并不特别稳定。尤为重要的是，我们强调，与d3z2-r2轨道具有强共价性的O(2)位点处局域自旋磁化率极低，这表明连接NiO2平面的Ni-d3z2-r2轨道中形成了充分发展的层间自旋单态。这些发现为理解层间自旋单态形成，以及通过连接NiO2平面的Ni-O(1)-Ni成键轨道发生的异常自旋重构提供了新视角；这些现象表征了双层镍酸盐La3Ni2O7的轨道选择性本质。

full_list.title_en: Landau theory of quenched criticality in linear in-context learning
full_list.title_zh: 线性上下文学习中淬火临界性的朗道理论
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.28059v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) allows a pretrained model to infer a new task from examples supplied in its prompt without updating its parameters. In linear models of ICL, the prediction error develops a double-descent singularity when the number of pretraining samples becomes comparable to the number of learnable parameters. We formulate this interpolation singularity as a critical phenomenon of a quenched disordered system. By comparing annealed and quenched descriptions of the same linear ICL model, we identify the connected sample-to-sample fluctuations of the learned parameters as the microscopic origin of the singular error. A Landau potential is constructed by integrating the cavity self-consistency equation for the renormalized ridge parameter ξ. The role of (magnetization) order parameter is played by ξ, while the bare ridge parameter łambda becomes its conjugate magnetic field. The normalized sample complexity τ acts as a temperature and the double-descent singularity occurs at the critical temperature τ_c =1. The Landau susceptibility is precisely the quantity that diverges in the fluctuation contribution to the prediction error. The order parameter is closely related to the fraction of zero eigenvalues of the empirical relaxation matrix in the ridgeless limit, which define flat directions in the learning dynamics. The Landau theory is generically cubic in the order parameter with critical exponents (βₘ̊ cᵣ,δₘ̊ cᵣ,γₘ̊ cᵣ)=(1,2,1). In the large-context regime, there appears a pseudogap-like regime characterized by suppressed order parameter. Predictions of the Landau theory are independently confirmed from numerical solutions of the original learning problem with good quantitative agreement. Our results pave the way for solid statistical-physics understanding of the interpolation criticality in linear in-context learning.
full_list.abstract_zh: 线性上下文学习中，当预训练样本数接近可学习参数数目时，预测误差会出现双降奇异性。本文将该插值奇异性表述为淬火无序系统的临界现象，并将学习参数的样本间连通涨落确定为奇异误差的微观来源。由重整化岭参数构造的朗道理论给出临界点τc=1、临界指数(βcr,δcr,γcr)=(1,2,1)，并得到原始学习问题数值解的验证。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 上下文学习（ICL）使预训练模型能够从提示词中给出的示例推断新任务，而无需更新其参数。在ICL的线性模型中，当预训练样本数与可学习参数数目相当时，预测误差会出现双降奇异性。我们将这种插值奇异性表述为淬火无序系统的临界现象。通过比较同一线性ICL模型的退火描述和淬火描述，我们识别出学习参数的样本间连通涨落是奇异误差的微观起源。通过积分重整化岭参数ξ的腔体自洽方程，构造了一个朗道势。序参量，即类似于磁化强度的量，由ξ承担，而裸岭参数λ成为其共轭磁场。归一化样本复杂度τ充当温度，双降奇异性发生在临界温度τc=1。朗道磁化率恰好就是在预测误差涨落贡献中发散的量。在无岭极限下，序参量与经验弛豫矩阵零本征值所占比例密切相关，而这些零本征值定义了学习动力学中的平坦方向。该朗道理论在序参量中一般为三次形式，其临界指数为(βcr,δcr,γcr)=(1,2,1)。在大上下文区间内，出现了一个以序参量受抑制为特征的赝能隙式区域。朗道理论的预测通过原始学习问题数值解得到了独立确认，并具有良好的定量一致性。我们的结果为扎实地从统计物理学角度理解线性上下文学习中的插值临界性开辟了道路。

full_list.title_en: Turning Zeeman splitting into switchable charge polarization in a double quantum dot
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Turning Zeeman splitting into switchable charge polarization in a double quantum dot
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.27625v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A magnetic field that acts identically on two quantum dots is not expected to move charge between them. Nevertheless, we show that a uniform Zeeman field can strongly reconfigure and even reverse the single-electron charge polarization of an asymmetric open double quantum dot. Using a symmetry-preserving Green's-function equation-of-motion approach, we identify regimes where the preferred dot occupation reverses while the system remains in the single-electron charge sector. Two distinct mechanisms produce this behavior. Unequal gate levels produce different occupation responses because the Zeeman-shifted resonances lie at different positions relative to the reservoir chemical potential, whereas unequal onsite interactions distinguish the dots through their many-body addition spectra. Coulomb blockade stabilizes the single-electron sector, causing the reservoir-mediated response to appear as spatial charge redistribution rather than a change in total occupation. Our results establish a mechanism for magnetic control of charge polarization at fixed electrostatic detuning.

full_list.title_en: A different kind of continuum limit for the three-dimensional U(1) gauge theory
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：A different kind of continuum limit for the three-dimensional U(1) gauge theory
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.27976v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In three-dimensional compact U(1) lattice gauge theory color confinement can be understood analytically through the dynamics of magnetic monopoles. However, its continuum limit is pathological, since the ratio of the glueball masses to the square root of the string tension vanishes as the continuum limit is approached. We investigate a simple extension of the Wilson action in which the total number of lattice monopoles is coupled to an additional parameter μ. By tuning β and μ simultaneously, we identify a line of constant physics along which the ratio of the lightest glueball mass to the square root of the string tension remains constant. We further show that the same scaling is satisfied, within numerical uncertainties, by the other low-lying glueball masses considered in this work. Along this trajectory, the string tension in lattice units decreases with increasing β, thus suggesting that the modified lattice action may provide a regularization of three-dimensional compact U(1) gauge theory with a physically well-behaved continuum limit.

full_list.title_en: A Three-Fluid Model of Dissipation at Surfaces in Superconducting Radiofrequency Cavities
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：A Three-Fluid Model of Dissipation at Surfaces in Superconducting Radiofrequency Cavities
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.28565v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Experiments on superconducting cavities have found that under large RF fields the quality factor can improve with increasing field amplitude, a so-called ``anti-Q slope.'' We numerically solve the Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations at a superconducting surface in a parallel magnetic field, finding at large fields there are surface quasiparticle states with energies below the bulk superconducting gap that emerge and disappear as the field cycles. Modifying the standard two-fluid model, we introduce a ``three''-fluid model where we partition the normal fluid to consider continuum and surface quasiparticle states separately. We compute dissipation in a semi-classical theory of conductivity, where we provide physical estimates of elastic scattering times of Bogoliubov quasiparticles with point-like impurities having potential strengths informed from complementary ab initio calculations of impurities in bulk niobium. We show, in this simple yet effective framework, how the relative scattering rates of surface and continuum quasiparticle states can play a role in producing an anti-Q slope while demonstrating how this model naturally includes a mechanism for turning the anti-Q slope on and off.

full_list.title_en: Gauge invariance, collective modes, and the justification of normal-state subtraction in Dirac superconductors
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Gauge invariance, collective modes, and the justification of normal-state subtraction in Dirac superconductors
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.28485v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In Dirac superconductors, the unbounded spectrum of low-energy Dirac models is known to give rise to unphysical interband contributions from deep-lying states to the electromagnetic response. To eliminate these contributions, normal-state subtraction (NSS), in which the normal-state response is subtracted from the superconducting-state response, has been widely employed. However, the relation between NSS and a gauge-invariant electromagnetic response, particularly the role of the vertex correction required by the Ward identity, has remained unclear. In this work, we consider a massive-Dirac model with s-wave pairing and analytically investigate the electromagnetic response at zero temperature by solving the Bethe--Salpeter equation and incorporating the collective-mode contribution to the electromagnetic vertex. We show that, in the static long-wavelength limit, the vertex correction exactly cancels the bare longitudinal response with NSS, yielding the vanishing longitudinal response required by gauge invariance. In contrast, the transverse component of the vertex correction vanishes in the long-wavelength limit, so that the gauge-invariant Meissner weight coincides with that obtained from the bare transverse response with NSS. Moreover, within the class of isotropic and analytic UV regularization terms, we show that gauge invariance uniquely fixes the regularization term in the static long-wavelength limit to the value prescribed by NSS. Our results thus provide a microscopic justification for NSS.

full_list.title_en: Super-resolution Control of Two-dimensional Quantum Emitters
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Super-resolution Control of Two-dimensional Quantum Emitters
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.28574v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Localized interlayer excitons in semiconducting transition-metal dichalcogenide heterobilayers are quantum emitters with a static electric dipole moment, making them excellent nanoscale charge sensors to probe correlated quantum phases in a proximal layer. These emitters are electrically tunable and inherit spin-valley selection rules, yet their deterministic spatial control remains challenging due to subwavelength confinement. Here, we present a platform that combines cryogenic optical spectroscopy with scanning probe microscopy to investigate trapped interlayer excitons in WSe₂/MoSe₂ bilayers. By exploiting AFM-based local Stark shift, we achieve super-resolution localization of emitters separated by only a few tens of nanometers and demonstrate deterministic control of individual charge states, including trion formation, opening a path towards coherent inter-dot coupling. Time-resolved measurements reveal tip-induced modification of the electromagnetic vacuum around individual emitters, thus controlling their radiative emission. Our multi-point charge sensing platform with optical readout is particularly well-suited to study fractionalization and anyon dynamics in semiconducting FCIs.

full_list.title_en: Field-like Perturbation Enabled Six-state Readout in Triaxial α-Fe₂O₃|Pt Bi-layers
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Field-like Perturbation Enabled Six-state Readout in Triaxial α-Fe₂O₃|Pt Bi-layers
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2606.23714v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Canted antiferromagnet α-Fe₂O₃|Pt bilayers offer a platform for multistate memory, but spin Hall magnetoresistance (SMR) readout cannot distinguish states separated by 180ⁱ̧rc, limiting detection to three states. We show that a field-like perturbation lifts the degeneracy of opposite states in α-Fe₂O₃, enabling the resolution of six states in the SMR signal. We introduce a dual-modulation SMR method to mitigate thermal drifts and enable reliable readout. Computations of first- and second-harmonic SMR reveal the role of exchange, anisotropy and field-like perturbations in resolving the states.

full_list.title_en: Long-lived memory in sliding spin chains
full_list.title_zh: 滑动自旋链中的长寿命记忆
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2607.14383v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study a system of two ferromagnetic one-dimensional Ising chains coupled to a thermal bath, which are driven out of equilibrium by being moved past one another at a constant speed. We show that even at modest speeds, magnetic friction between the two chains significantly increases the ability of the system to order. In particular, at inverse temperature β, Ising coupling J, and sliding speed v, the dynamics retains memory of its initial magnetization for a time that increases from exp(O(β J)) at v = 0 to exp(O((b J)²v)) when v>v_c, where v_c is a small constant. Magnetic friction thus provides a simple mechanism for parametrically slowing down thermalization in a one-dimensional magnet.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文研究两条与热浴耦合、以恒定速度相对滑动的铁磁一维伊辛链。结果表明，即使在中等滑动速度下，链间磁摩擦也会显著增强体系的有序能力，并使初始磁化的记忆时间呈参数化增长。该机制为显著减缓一维磁体热化提供了简单途径。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了一个由两条铁磁性一维伊辛链构成的系统；该系统与热浴耦合，并通过以恒定速度彼此滑动而被驱动至非平衡态。我们表明，即使在中等速度下，两条链之间的磁摩擦也会显著提高系统形成有序态的能力。具体而言，在逆温度为 β、伊辛耦合为 J、滑动速度为 v 时，系统动力学保留其初始磁化记忆的时间会从 v=0 时的 exp(O(βJ))，增大至当 v>v_c 时的 exp(O((βJ)²v))，其中 v_c 是一个较小常数。因此，磁摩擦提供了一种能够以参数化方式减缓一维磁体热化的简单机制。

full_list.abstract: Author(s): Marios H. Michael, Duilio De Santis, Eugene A. Demler, and Patrick A. Lee Intense terahertz light triggers a flux-Floquet instability in high-temperature superconductors, generating a giant magnetic response that reveals bound electron pairs survive well above the superconducting transition temperature. [Phys. Rev. X 16, 031055] Published Mon Aug 31, 2026
full_list.abstract_zh: 强太赫兹光可在高温超导体中触发磁通-Floquet 不稳定性，并产生巨大的磁响应。该响应揭示束缚电子对可在超导转变温度之上持续存在。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 作者：Marios H. Michael、Duilio De Santis、Eugene A. Demler 和 Patrick A. Lee。强太赫兹光在高温超导体中触发磁通-Floquet 不稳定性，产生巨大的磁响应，并揭示束缚电子对在远高于超导转变温度时仍然存在。[《Physical Review X》16，031055]，发表于 2026 年 8 月 31 日。
full_list.summary: 强太赫兹光可在高温超导体中触发磁通-Floquet 不稳定性，并产生巨大的磁响应。该响应揭示束缚电子对可在超导转变温度之上持续存在。
authors: Marios H. Michael, Duilio De Santis, Eugene A. Demler, and Patrick A. Lee
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《涨落超导体中的磁通-Floquet 不稳定性》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: A Reproducible Method for Mapping Electricity Transmission Infrastructure for Space Weather Risk Assessment
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：A Reproducible Method for Mapping Electricity Transmission Infrastructure for Space Weather Risk Assessment
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2412.17685v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Space weather risk assessment is constrained by the lack of available asset information needed to model geomagnetically induced currents (GICs) in electricity transmission infrastructure. We propose a systematic method that enables risk analysts to collect their own open-source substation data. Using a web browser platform for annotation, we convert OpenStreetMap (OSM) substation locations into high-resolution, component-level mappings of electricity transmission assets. We convert an initial 1,313 high-voltage (>=230 kV) substations to 52,273 components using low-altitude, satellite, and Street View imagery accessed through Google Earth, identifying 7,949 transformers. Compared to the OSM baseline, this approach provides detailed insights on voltage levels and substation configurations. We then construct a geospatial GIC network for the Tennessee Valley Authority (TVA) region, comparing May 2024 results with the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign 150-bus (UIUC150) synthetic network and with measured ground GICs at 13 monitoring devices. The transformer types at unannotated substations and the grounding resistances are unknown, so we sample both across a Monte Carlo ensemble. This gives a median TVA 95th-percentile peak ground GIC of 29.1 A, with a 90 percent confidence interval of 23.9-36.1 A. The UIUC150 network yields a 95th-percentile peak ground GIC of 35.8 A under the same forcing, falling within this interval, and the modeled time series broadly capture the temporal morphology of the geomagnetic storm at the monitoring sites. This method shows promise for spatially explicit, screening-level GIC assessment without requiring access to operator data.

full_list.title_en: Voltage and Electromagnetic Fault Injectioin in TinyML: Attacks and Countermeasures
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Voltage and Electromagnetic Fault Injectioin in TinyML: Attacks and Countermeasures
full_list.abstract: Tiny Machine Learning (TinyML) algorithms, designed to operate on constrained devices such as those found in Internet of Things (IoT) systems, are vulnerable to adversarial threats, including fault injection attacks. These attacks exploit physical means to induce errors in computation, compromising the reliability of the device and the TinyML models running on it. This work investigates the operation of TinyML models under fault injection attacks. Through systematic experimentation with voltage glitching and EM fault injection attacks on microcontrollers, this work identifiesconfigurations that adversaries can exploit to induce faults without triggering a system reset, thus focusing on finding the more stealthy attacks. This study analyzes four types of TinyML models, and demonstrates that all four evaluated TinyML models will generate inference outputs with reduced accuracy under the two types of fault injection attacks. Further, in some instances, this work shows that it may be feasible for the attackers to use the faults to cause inference operations to return a predictable output, not just random incorrect inference results. This highlights the need for more robust fault injection protection mechanisms in TinyML implementations. In order to provide one such protection, this work demonstrates the use of Randomized Self-Reduction (RSR) schemes and majority voting for intermediate values as a means to protect the TinyML models.

full_list.title_en: Real-Time Monitoring of MHD Liquid Metal Flows with Shallow Recurrent Decoders
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Real-Time Monitoring of MHD Liquid Metal Flows with Shallow Recurrent Decoders
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.28366v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: State estimation in magnetohydrodynamic flows is critical for real-time monitoring of liquid metal blankets in tokamak fusion reactors. Due to the multiphysics nature of these phenomena, high-fidelity simulations are computationally prohibitive for real-time applications. This work investigates a data- driven Reduced Order Model framework: the Shallow Recurrent Decoder (SHRED) coupled with Principal Component Analysis, to map sparse temperature measurements to the full thermo-hydraulic system's state. The major contribution of this work lies in the two-parameter analysis of a fully three-dimensional domain representative of the DEMO breeding blanket configuration. Here, the flow is subjected to an external magnetic field varying in direction and intensity and is hindered by two cylinders acting as a water-cooling system, which impose a temperature boundary condition on their surfaces. This double-parametric magnetic variation induces nonlinear transitions in the flow dynamics, ranging from chaotic behavior at low magnetic field intensities to laminarized regimes at high intensities, characterized by the formation of asymmetric side layers at an inclination angle of 30 degrees. SHRED reconstruction maintains a mean relative error of approximately 5% for the temperature, pressure, and velocity fields. This accuracy is maintained across both weak and strong magnetic fields, ranging from 0.075 T to 0.300 T, and for inclination angles from 5 to 30 degrees, reflecting its dominant toroidal component. These errors are only slightly larger than the lower error bound dictated by low-rank truncation. The results establish SHRED as a reliable state estimator for complex and realistic engineering applications involving completely unseen parametric scenarios and validate it as an accurate real-time state estimation technique suitable for online monitoring and control of real facilities.

full_list.title_en: Solar Magnetic Configuration Control over Radiation Belt Electrons
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Solar Magnetic Configuration Control over Radiation Belt Electrons
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.28309v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Earth is surrounded by two highly dynamic concentric belts of particle radiation. The outer radiation belt exhibits coherent variability at solar-cycle, seasonal, and 27-day (Carrington) timescales. While the solar-cycle and Carrington variations have been attributed to the recurrence of coronal hole solar wind, the seasonal variation has long been explained by local geometric effects that modulate the solar wind-magnetosphere coupling. Here, we challenge this paradigm by showing that the periodic recurrence of coronal hole solar wind likewise drives the seasonal variation. We further demonstrate that the Alfvénic nature of this solar wind is responsible for the observed electron flux enhancement in the outer radiation belt. These findings provide a unifying framework linking solar magnetic topology, solar wind properties, and magnetospheric dynamics across multiple timescales at Earth and beyond.

full_list.title_en: Validation of quasi-two-dimensional model of convection in a transverse magnetic field
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Validation of quasi-two-dimensional model of convection in a transverse magnetic field
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.28023v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this study we examine applicability of the quasi-two-dimensional (Q2D) model of natural convection in a laterally heated rectangular box subject to a transverse magnetic field. For this purpose, results obtained using the Q2D model are compared with fully three-dimensional calculations for rectangular boxes with a square cross-section and horizontally elongated ones with the length to height ratio 8. The width to height ratio is varied from 1 to 10. It is argued that the Q2D model is valid under certain conditions, which include perfect thermal and electrical insulation of the spanwise boundaries and reflection symmetry with respect to the spanwise midplane. It is shown that under these conditions, the Q2D model yields quantitatively correct results for boxes with square cross-section, as well as for horizontally elongated cavities, independently on the width to height ratio. Three-dimensional results obtained for boxes with perfectly conducting walls exhibit asymptotics at gradually increasing width ratio, which, however, does not agree with the predictions of an amended Q2D model. It is shown also that when is applicable, the Q2D model can correctly predict steady-oscillatory transition of three-dimensional flows. It is proposed to seek for extensions of the Q2D model for cavities with perfectly conducting spanwise boundaries.

full_list.title_en: Electromagnetic pressure-gradient-driven instabilities with moderate high mode numbers in tokamak plasmas
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Electromagnetic pressure-gradient-driven instabilities with moderate high mode numbers in tokamak plasmas
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.28367v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pressure gradient-driven instabilities are investigated in tokamak plasmas using the global gyrokinetic code EUTERPE emphasizing the role of moderate high mode numbers. As the normalized plasma pressure β is increased, there is a well-known, sudden transition from ion-temperature-gradient (ITG) instabilities to kinetic ballooning modes (KBM), if the magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) geometry is held fixed. However, if the equilibrium field is recomputed for each value of β, so that the equilibrium is consistent with the stability calculation, the transition can disappear. In a number of cases, we are only able to find an ITG-KBM transition if inconsistent equilibria are used. In the MHD unstable regime, gyrokinetic simulations and MHD stability calculations show good agreement for moderate ratios of ion temperature gradient to density gradient and small values of the ion gyro-radius. Otherwise, non-MHD contributions are important, such as the diamagnetic stabilization and ion wave--particle resonant effects.

full_list.title_en: AlGaN/GaN Hall-Effect Sensor for In-Situ Magnetic Field Monitoring of the HSX Stellarator
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：AlGaN/GaN Hall-Effect Sensor for In-Situ Magnetic Field Monitoring of the HSX Stellarator
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.26704v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Direct magnetic field sensors can address integration drift commonly observed in conventional inductive magnetic diagnostics used in fusion systems. In this work, an AlGaN/GaN Hall-effect sensor was fabricated, packaged, and deployed inside the Helically Symmetric eXperiment (HSX)---the first quasi-helically symmetric stellarator, operating with a 1 T on-axis magnetic field and up to 200 kW of launched electron cyclotron resonance heating (ECRH) power---for in-situ magnetic field monitoring near the plasma edge. The sensor leverages the high-mobility two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG) formed in the AlGaN/GaN heterostructure for sensitive magnetic field measurement, while the wide-bandgap GaN material system provides thermal robustness for harsh-environment operation. During 68 consecutive plasma discharge shots, the sensor remained functional and produced clear transient responses associated with plasma ignition and discharge dynamics. Comparisons between biased and unbiased operation, as well as plasma-discharge and coil-only shots, confirmed that the response originated from the biased Hall-effect sensor element. Furthermore, the sensor output exhibited temporal correlation with the plasma stored energy measured by the HSX diamagnetic loop across high-energy, late-breakdown, and failed-breakdown discharges.

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《兼具导电性与隔热性的聚吡咯涂覆非织造织物：用于可穿戴热管理、电磁干扰屏蔽与传感》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

research_direction_note: 本日文献与团队研究的交集主要集中在密度泛函理论和电子结构计算、有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量、热力学自由能、相稳定与有限温度建模、第一性原理标注与结构优化，并落到声子、有限温度和输运性质、晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系、HfO₂ 基铁电体、氧空位和极化翻转、铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程。对现有工作最直接的价值是提供可复用的表示、采样或验证流程，而不是替代具体材料体系的物理判断。后续筛选应优先核对原文数据是否包含结构、能量、力、应力、极化、自旋或有限温度轨迹，再决定是否迁移到铁电、磁性、缺陷和外场驱动模拟。

core_items.title_en: DFT and MLIP study of solute segregation to coherent and semi-coherent α-Fe/Fe₃C interfaces
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：DFT and MLIP study of solute segregation to coherent and semi-coherent α-Fe/Fe₃C interfaces
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2602.14603v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Solute segregation to interfaces significantly impacts material behavior. A large majority of theoretical works focus on grain boundaries and coherent interfaces. Studies on semi-coherent interfaces are usually prohibited by the structural complexity, yielding models beyond the practical capability of density functional theory (DFT), or chemical complexity, restricted by the availability of (classical) interatomic potentials. This work investigates solute segregation to the coherent and semi-coherent α-Fe/Fe₃C interface in pearlite and its effect on mechanical properties using novel universal machine learning interatomic potentials (uMLIPs). DFT calculated solution enthalpies, segregation energetics, and changes in cohesion at the coherent interface are used to benchmark several state-of-the-art uMLIPs. We find that the GRACE-2L-OAM and GRACE-2L-OMAT models most accurately reproduce the quantum-mechanical predictions. While Cu has the strongest segregation energy of approx -0.3 eV to the coherent interface among the investigated tramp and trace elements, all of them, As, Cr, Cu, Mo, Ni, P, Sb, and Sn, exhibit significantly more negative segregation values reaching below approx -1.5 eV in the presence of the misfit dislocation at the semi-coherent interface. The deepest traps are identified in the vicinity of the dislocation core, although the spatial distribution of segregation energies differs markedly among the solute species. The cohesion of the coherent interface is strongly reduced by Sb, Sn, P, and As, and only mildly by Cu, whereas Ni shows a negligible effect, and Cr and Mo slightly enhance cohesion. In contrast, all investigated solutes (except for P) tend to embrittle the semi-coherent interface, with Sn and, especially, Sb having the strongest impact in tensile tests performed in the out-of-plane direction. Abstract shortened for ArXiv.

authors: Amin Reiners-Sakic, Ronald Schnitzer, David Holec
core_items.focus_summary: 该工作结合密度泛函理论与通用机器学习原子间势，研究珠光体中相干及半相干α-Fe/Fe₃C界面的溶质偏聚和界面结合行为。作者以DFT的溶解焓、偏聚能和内聚变化为基准评估多种模型，发现GRACE系列模型对量子力学结果的再现较好。
core_items.focus_relation: 与团队的第一性原理计算、机器学习势、磁性材料和界面缺陷相关研究具有较高关联。其以小尺度DFT数据校准通用MLIP、进而处理复杂大尺度界面的流程可供材料缺陷与界面模拟借鉴。
core_items.focus_suggestion: 可重点阅读其针对半相干界面构型和偏聚能的验证方案，并评估等变机器学习势在含磁性自由度铁基界面中的可靠性。可进一步扩展至应力、温度及溶质共偏聚条件下的界面结构演化与力学响应。
core_items.method_point: 该工作以DFT计算作为基准，针对相干及半相干α-Fe/Fe3C界面构建机器学习原子间势，并用其补足半相干界面因失配位错和大超胞而超出常规DFT可承受范围的问题。计算对象包含不同溶质、界面位点及局域结构环境，核心输出是偏聚能及其与界面结构的关联；所给摘要未披露MLIP的具体架构、截断半径、训练集规模或误差指标，因此不能据此断言采用MACE、NEP或equivariant GNN。方法上的关键是以DFT覆盖代表性局域构型，再由势函数对大尺度半相干界面采样。
core_items.related_work: 它直接延续晶界溶质偏聚的DFT与经典势研究，但将研究重点由理想晶界、相干界面推进到含失配位错网络的α-Fe/Fe3C半相干界面。与仅拟合体相弹性或点缺陷的MLIP不同，训练分布必须同时覆盖bcc Fe、Fe3C、界面低配位原子、应变和不同化学组分；这与团队中从事铁磁金属缺陷、原子尺度势函数、相场或力学耦合的研究线可直接衔接。它也与第8篇的P晶界偏聚形成互补：前者问相界，后者问晶界间隙占位。
core_items.implication: 可先以团队已有α-Fe、Fe3C及P、C、Mn、Si等元素的DFT数据库建立主动学习池，显式加入不同取向关系、失配位错核心、界面间距和溶质浓度的超胞。训练时将偏聚能差、原子力和应力共同纳入保留集，随后在10^4至10^5原子半相干界面上进行NPT退火与MC/MD溶质交换采样，得到温度依赖的位点占据率。验证应回算高不确定度位点的DFT偏聚能，并将预测的富集位置与APT、TEM-EDS或已发表界面偏聚趋势比较。

core_items.title_en: uMOF: A Universal Database, Benchmark, and Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials for Metal-Organic Frameworks
core_items.title_zh: uMOF：面向金属有机框架的通用数据库、基准与机器学习原子间势
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2608.28100v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundation machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) deliver near-ab-initio accuracy at a fraction of the computational cost, yet their promise for Metal-organic Frameworks (MOFs) remains largely unrealized as large unit cells make first-principles training data expensive to generate, fine-tuned models are scarce, and experimentally grounded benchmarks are scarcer still. We introduce uMOF, a three-part contribution addressing this gap. First, we release the largest and most accurate density functional theory dataset for MOFs to date, computed at the r²SCAN-D4 level of theory across 85524 configurations spanning 19950 unique frameworks and 79 elements, covering empty and gas-loaded structures, geometry optimizations, equations of state, and finite-temperature molecular dynamics. Second, we release a literature-mined benchmark of 3986 verified property values (3146 experimental) extracted from 626 papers by a seven-stage, checkpointed multi-pass large language model pipeline, linked to more than 650 crystallographic information files. Third, we release two universal MLIPs for MOFs, uMOF-MH and uMOF-POLAR, fine-tuned from two architecturally distinct MACE foundation models on the uMOF dataset. On near-equilibrium, ``Tier-1'' properties (bulk modulus, phonon-derived heat capacity) the uMOF models perform comparably to existing foundation and fine-tuned baselines. On harder, dynamics-sensitive properties like gas adsorption enthalpies via Widom insertion and adsorption isotherms, the uMOF models outperform every baseline we test, including MOF-specialized gas-capture models trained on datasets up to three orders of magnitude larger, cutting error by more than 80% to within experimental uncertainty. We trace this advantage to the physical diversity of the training data and to level of theory where a small (1.7%) fraction of MD simulations is decisive for MLIP stability.
core_items.abstract_zh: 本文提出uMOF，包括迄今规模最大且精度最高的MOF密度泛函理论数据集、从文献中挖掘的经核验性质基准，以及两种通用MOF机器学习原子间势。该数据集涵盖85524个构型、19950种框架和79种元素，基准包含从626篇论文提取的3986个性质值。uMOF模型在近平衡性质上与现有模型相当，而在气体吸附焓和吸附等温线等动力学敏感性质上优于所有测试基线，将误差降低80%以上至实验不确定度范围内。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 基础机器学习原子间势（MLIP）能够以远低于计算成本的代价实现接近第一性原理的精度，但其在金属有机框架（MOF）中的前景在很大程度上尚未实现，因为大晶胞使第一性原理训练数据的生成成本高昂，微调模型稀少，而以实验为依据的基准更为稀缺。我们提出uMOF，这是一项由三部分组成的工作，旨在填补这一空白。首先，我们发布了迄今规模最大、精度最高的MOF密度泛函理论数据集：该数据集在r2SCAN-D4理论水平下计算，涵盖85524个构型、19950种不同框架和79种元素，包括空载与气体负载结构、几何优化、状态方程和有限温度分子动力学。第二，我们发布了一个通过文献挖掘建立的基准，其中包含由七阶段、带检查点的多轮大语言模型流程从626篇论文中提取的3986个经核验性质值，其中3146个为实验值，并与650多个晶体学信息文件相连接。第三，我们发布了两种面向MOF的通用MLIP，即uMOF-MH和uMOF-POLAR；它们是在uMOF数据集上，从两个架构不同的MACE基础模型微调而来。对于近平衡的“第一层级”性质，如体积模量和由声子导出的热容，uMOF模型的表现与现有基础模型和微调基线相当。对于更困难、对动力学敏感的性质，例如通过Widom插入计算的气体吸附焓和吸附等温线，uMOF模型优于我们测试的每一种基线，包括在规模大至三个数量级的数据集上训练的MOF专用气体捕集模型，将误差降低80%以上，达到实验不确定度范围内。我们将这一优势归因于训练数据的物理多样性和所采用的理论水平，其中仅占1.7%的分子动力学模拟对MLIP稳定性具有决定性作用。
core_items.summary: 本文提出uMOF，包括迄今规模最大且精度最高的MOF密度泛函理论数据集、从文献中挖掘的经核验性质基准，以及两种通用MOF机器学习原子间势。该数据集涵盖85524个构型、19950种框架和79种元素，基准包含从626篇论文提取的3986个性质值。uMOF模型在近平衡性质上与现有模型相当，而在气体吸附焓和吸附等温线等动力学敏感性质上优于所有测试基线，将误差降低80%以上至实验不确定度范围内。

Persson (Materials Sciences Division, Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, Berkeley, CA, USA, Department of Materials Science & Engineering, University of California, Berkeley, CA, USA)
core_items.focus_summary: 论文发布了面向金属有机框架的通用数据库、实验性质基准和机器学习原子间势。其数据集覆盖大量框架结构、气体负载构型、方程状态和有限温度分子动力学，并据此微调适用于 MOF 的机器学习势。
core_items.focus_relation: 与我们的机器学习势、材料数据库、主动学习和大规模分子动力学方法相关，但研究对象主要是金属有机框架，不属于团队当前重点材料体系。其数据集构建、实验基准关联和通用势微调策略可迁移到电池材料、钙钛矿或缺陷半导体研究。
core_items.focus_suggestion: 可借鉴其数据集和基准测试流程，为 HfO2 铁电体、卤化物钙钛矿、固态电解质和二维材料建立面向有限温度与缺陷的机器学习势。重点应评估势函数对相变、离子迁移、长程库仑作用和极化性质的描述能力。
core_items.method_point: uMOF建立含85,524个DFT构型、19,950种框架和79种元素的MOF数据集，并从626篇论文抽取并核验3,986个实验或文献性质形成外部基准。作者训练两种通用机器学习原子间势，评价不局限于近平衡结构与能量，还覆盖气体吸附焓和吸附等温线等对柔性骨架、客体相互作用和有限温采样敏感的量；摘要称这些指标相对测试基线的误差下降超过80%。所给信息没有给出两种势的网络类型、色散处理、吸附系综或DFT泛函，不能将其等同于特定MACE或NEP实现。
core_items.related_work: 该路线呼应MatBench、Open Catalyst及通用材料势的大规模预训练思路，但MOF的难点是孔道化学、金属节点配位、柔性框架与客体吸附同时存在，单纯优化晶体结构误差并不足以保证吸附预测。它与团队中从事多孔材料数据库、吸附热力学、图神经网络和第一性原理筛选的研究线相关，也可为铁电多孔框架或磁性MOF的结构-磁序联合建模提供数据组织范式。相较无机铁电体如BaTiO3，MOF更强调弱相互作用、构象多样性和化学元素覆盖。
core_items.implication: 团队可从已有磁性MOF、极性MOF及客体吸附数据中抽取结构、能量、力、应力、磁矩和电荷，按框架家族而非随机构型划分训练、验证和测试集以避免结构泄漏。对目标材料在298 K及目标压力下开展GCMC或MD，使用MLIP产生构型并以少量DFT单点校正吸附焓；若涉及铁电性，再沿极化翻转路径补充受限畸变构型。验证应同时报告晶格、声子稳定性、吸附等温线、吸附热，并对未见金属节点和未见客体做外推测试。

core_items.title_en: Electronic structure, magnetic interactions, and magnonics of 2D trichloride materials
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：Electronic structure, magnetic interactions, and magnonics of 2D trichloride materials
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2608.27747v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Using advanced density functional theory, this study demonstrates the robust thermodynamic, structural, and dynamical stability of pristine, 3d-doped (Ti, Cr), and 4f-doped (Ce) transition metal trichlorides (MCl3). While standard generalized gradient approximation (GGA) incorrectly predicts metallic behavior, hybrid functional calculations successfully capture their semiconducting nature, yielding accurate band gaps of 2.54 eV (VCl3), 4.01 eV (CrCl3), and 2.61 eV (TiCl3). These materials exhibit intrinsic ferromagnetism, with CrCl3 displaying overlapping topological features in both its magnon and phonon dispersions along the high-symmetry K direction, which induces magnon-phonon coupling. Incorporating 3d dopants into VCl3 successfully tunes the bandgap (1.32 eV for Ti and 2.74 eV for Cr) without destroying ferromagnetism, while 4f Ce-doping in CrCl3 introduces localized states below the Fermi level that yield strong nearest-neighbor exchange coupling. Ultimately, this electronic and magnetic tunability highlights the potential of these 2D trichlorides in advanced spintronic functionalities.

authors: Krishna Prasad Chapai, Yogendra Limbu, Gopi Chandra Kaphle, Durga Paudyal
core_items.focus_summary: 该研究基于密度泛函理论和杂化泛函计算二维三氯化物的结构稳定性、电子结构、磁性及磁振子性质，并研究Ti、Cr和Ce掺杂对带隙和交换作用的调控。结果显示这些材料具有本征铁磁性，CrCl3中还存在磁振子-声子耦合及潜在拓扑特征。
core_items.focus_relation: 与我们的二维范德华磁体、磁性材料、非共线磁性、自旋哈密顿量、磁振子-声子耦合和自旋电子学方向直接相关。其掺杂调控电子结构与交换相互作用的方法，可用于发展二维磁性材料设计和自旋输运研究。
core_items.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步计算不同磁构型下的交换参数、磁各向异性、Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用和有限温度磁相变，并构建自旋哈密顿量结合蒙特卡洛模拟。还可使用声子与磁振子谱、非绝热动力学或自旋-晶格动力学定量研究磁振子-声子耦合及磁阻尼。
core_items.method_point: 该文以先进DFT考察二维MCl3三氯化物的本征、Ti/Cr等3d掺杂及Ce等4f掺杂情形，依次判定热力学、结构和动力学稳定性，并计算电子结构、磁相互作用和磁振子性质。其明确技术结论是常规GGA错误给出金属性，而杂化泛函恢复正确的绝缘电子结构；随后应从不同自旋构型能量映射交换参数，并以此求解自旋波，但摘要未列出具体杂化比例、U值、k网格、超胞和磁振子求解器。这里的可靠性瓶颈是带隙与交换常数对交换关联处理的敏感性。
core_items.related_work: 该研究与CrI3、CrGeTe3、CrSBr等二维范德瓦耳斯磁体的“电子关联-各向异性-磁振子”研究同源，但将卤化物骨架及3d/4f掺杂作为调控维度。它提示只用GGA或固定经验U来训练磁性数据库可能把绝缘磁体误标为金属；这与团队中从事二维磁性、DFT+U/杂化泛函标定、磁振子模型及机器学习交换参数拟合的方向直接相关。与CrI3中自旋轨道耦合主导的各向异性相比，4f掺杂还会引入更局域且多重态复杂的磁性来源。
core_items.implication: 可选取团队已有CrI3、CrSBr及候选MCl3单层，统一生成应变、缺陷、掺杂浓度和多自旋序构型；用少量HSE或经标定的DFT+U计算作为高保真标签，GGA数据仅作预训练。以equivariant GNN学习局域结构到自旋构型能、磁矩和交换张量的映射，再在大超胞上进行经典蒙特卡洛和线性自旋波计算，扫描居里温度及磁振子带隙。应以HSE复算带隙、以不同磁序能差复算J，并用Raman、MOKE或非弹性散射可获得的声子和磁振子特征交叉验证。

core_items.title_en: Charge transfer and competing symmetry breaking drive orbital reconstruction and emergent ferromagnetism in insulating oxide superlattices
core_items.title_zh: 电荷转移与竞争性对称性破缺驱动绝缘氧化物超晶格中的轨道重构和涌现铁磁性
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2608.28107v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electron correlation, hopping, and ligand-to-metal charge transfer collectively lead to diverse electronic and magnetic phenomena in 3d transition-metal oxides, where directional d orbitals make hopping highly sensitive to symmetry-dependent orbital overlap. Heterostructure engineering with atomically flat interfaces adds symmetry-breaking charge transfer as a further route to emergent behavior, yet whether interfacial mismatch between constituent oxides of a superlattice shapes ground states independent of epitaxial strain remains unresolved. Here we examine superlattices combining NdNiO₃ with Mott-insulating NdMnO₃. Varying layer thickness and combining transport with X-ray spectroscopy, we show that electron transfer from NdMnO₃ to NdNiO₃ drives a room-temperature insulating state with a distinct electronic structure, accompanied by a reversal in orbital symmetry beyond simple strain considerations, underscoring the interface's central role. These reconstructions stabilize an emergent ferromagnetic insulating state arising from interfacial Ni²⁺-O-Mn⁴⁺ superexchange. Our results establish a pathway to interface-engineered ferromagnetic insulating phases via competing interactions, with potential for spin-insulatronic applications.
core_items.abstract_zh: 本文研究NdNiO3与Mott绝缘体NdMnO3构成的超晶格，考察界面电荷转移和对称性破缺对基态的作用。调节层厚并结合输运和X射线谱学发现，从NdMnO3至NdNiO3的电子转移驱动室温绝缘态，并导致不能仅以外延应变解释的轨道对称性反转。界面Ni2+-O-Mn4+超交换由此稳定涌现的铁磁绝缘态，为界面工程化铁磁绝缘相及自旋绝缘电子学应用提供了路径。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 电子关联、跃迁以及配体至金属的电荷转移共同导致3d过渡金属氧化物中多样的电子和磁性现象；在这些材料中，具有方向性的d轨道使跃迁对依赖对称性的轨道重叠高度敏感。具有原子级平整界面的异质结构工程，将由对称性破缺引起的电荷转移作为获得涌现行为的另一条途径；然而，超晶格组分氧化物之间的界面失配是否能独立于外延应变而塑造基态，仍未得到解决。本文考察了结合NdNiO3和Mott绝缘体NdMnO3的超晶格。通过改变层厚度并结合输运测量与X射线谱学，我们表明，从NdMnO3向NdNiO3的电子转移驱动了室温绝缘态及其独特电子结构，同时伴随超出简单应变考量的轨道对称性反转，凸显了界面的核心作用。这些重构稳定了一种涌现的铁磁绝缘态，该态源于界面Ni2+-O-Mn4+超交换。我们的结果确立了通过竞争相互作用获得界面工程化铁磁绝缘相的路径，并有望应用于自旋绝缘电子学。
core_items.summary: 本文研究NdNiO3与Mott绝缘体NdMnO3构成的超晶格，考察界面电荷转移和对称性破缺对基态的作用。调节层厚并结合输运和X射线谱学发现，从NdMnO3至NdNiO3的电子转移驱动室温绝缘态，并导致不能仅以外延应变解释的轨道对称性反转。界面Ni2+-O-Mn4+超交换由此稳定涌现的铁磁绝缘态，为界面工程化铁磁绝缘相及自旋绝缘电子学应用提供了路径。
authors: Nandana Bhattacharya, Ranjan Kumar Patel, Siddharth Kumar, Sourav Chowdhury, Manav Beniwal, Suresh Chandra Joshi, Prithwijit Mandal, Jayjit Kumar Dey, Weibin Li, Manuel Valvidares, Zhan Zhang, Hua Zhou, Andrei Gloskovskii, Christoph Schlueter, Christoph Klewe, Srimanta Middey
core_items.focus_summary: 论文研究 NdNiO3/NdMnO3 氧化物超晶格中的界面电荷转移、轨道重构和对称性破缺。研究发现，NdMnO3 向 NdNiO3 的电子转移可形成室温绝缘态，并通过 Ni2+-O-Mn4+ 超交换稳定界面诱导的铁磁绝缘态。
core_items.focus_relation: 与我们的磁性材料、磁性超晶格、界面电荷转移、轨道重构和自旋相关相互作用方向相关。虽然工作以实验表征为主，但其界面诱导磁性和超交换机制适合用第一性原理、有效自旋哈密顿量及蒙特卡洛方法进一步解析。
core_items.focus_suggestion: 建议开展不同层厚、应变和界面终止条件下的第一性原理计算，分离电荷转移、晶格失配与应变对磁基态的贡献。还可提取交换参数和磁各向异性，研究温度依赖的界面磁序。
core_items.method_point: 该文通过改变NdNiO3/NdMnO3超晶格层厚，结合电输运与X射线谱学，分离界面电荷转移、外延应变和竞争性对称性破缺对基态的贡献。实验指出电子由NdMnO3转移至NdNiO3，形成室温绝缘态并引起不能由应变单独解释的轨道对称性反转；界面Ni2+-O-Mn4+超交换稳定铁磁绝缘相。摘要没有报告机器学习模型或具体第一性原理设置，因此其ML关联应定位为可供结构-谱学联合学习的高价值界面基准，而非已完成的ML预测。
core_items.related_work: 这与LaNiO3/LaMnO3、LaAlO3/SrTiO3等氧化物异质结中电荷转移、轨道极化和界面磁性的研究呼应，但NdNiO3本身的金属-绝缘体转变和NdMnO3的Mott关联使层厚依赖更难由简单能带对齐解释。它可连接团队中从事钙钛矿铁电、氧化物磁性界面、DFT+U/DMFT及XAS解析的研究线；若团队已有BaTiO3或极性氧化物平台，还可比较极化电场与化学电荷转移两种界面控制量。与纯应变工程不同，文中强调轨道重构必须显式处理价态变化。
core_items.implication: 可围绕(NdNiO3)m/(NdMnO3)n建立层厚、终止面、氧八面体转角和应变的结构库，使用DFT+U并以XAS/XLD约束Ni、Mn价态和轨道占据；对关键构型用DMFT或混合泛函做校准。随后以图网络或高斯过程学习结构描述符到电荷转移、交换符号和绝缘隙的映射，在未计算层厚上做贝叶斯优化。实验验证应制备同一应变基底上的厚度楔形样品，联测输运、XMCD、XLD和STEM-EELS，并与模型预测的界面价态剖面对照。

core_items.title_en: OrbGNN: A Wave function-based Machine Learning Interelectronic Representation
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：OrbGNN: A Wave function-based Machine Learning Interelectronic Representation
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2608.27806v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have become emerging tools in molecular modeling and computational chemistry. By learning high-dimensional potential energy surfaces from quantum chemical data, MLIPs enable accurate and efficient predictions of structural, thermodynamic, and dynamical properties. However, such models have limitations in predictions of electronic properties and the effects of static electron correlation due to their lack of electronic structure information. This work presents OrbGNN, an electronic structure graph architecture analogous to molecular graph and MLIP frameworks, where pair-orbital interactions constitute the graph representation, while orbital entanglement encodes the connectivity between them. By embedding information derived from orbital correlation metrics directly into the graph topology, OrbGNN provides a compact representation of a molecule s orbital landscape and electron correlation patterns. Analysis of the behavior of the feature space in an orbital graph are shown to demonstrate model robustness. The model is evaluated for the dissociation of nitrogen and for a larger dataset of diatomic molecules. Finally, the OrbGNN model is applied to a set of octahedral iron(II) complexes to predict spin-state energy gaps.
core_items.summary: arXiv:2608.27806v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have become emerging tools in molecular modeling and computational chemistry. By learning high-dimension…
authors: Brody Quebedeaux, Shahzad Akram, Markus Reiher, Konstantinos D. Vogiatzis
core_items.focus_summary: 该工作提出OrbGNN，以成对轨道相互作用构建图结构，并将轨道纠缠和电子关联信息嵌入图连接关系。模型在氮分子解离等电子关联问题上用于表征轨道空间及其特征鲁棒性。
core_items.focus_relation: 该方向与团队发展的图神经网络、等变神经网络以及机器学习电子结构和Kohn-Sham哈密顿量存在方法学关联。其显式引入轨道关联信息的表示方式，对面向强关联材料的电子哈密顿量学习有启发。
core_items.focus_suggestion: 建议评估该表示能否从分子体系推广至周期性固体、能带和局域轨道基下的材料问题。可进一步比较其与Wannier轨道哈密顿量学习、密度矩阵预测方法在缺陷和磁性体系中的数据效率与可解释性。
core_items.method_point: OrbGNN提出以波函数为基础的机器学习“电子间表示”，目标是突破常规MLIP主要依赖原子种类、距离和局域几何描述符的限制。按摘要可知，它将量子化学波函数所含电子结构信息编码进图模型，用于学习高维势能面及结构、热力学和动力学性质；但摘要截断，未给出节点和边特征是否来自轨道系数、密度矩阵或双电子积分，也未给出网络层数、训练目标及数据集。因而不能把它误述为已验证的凝聚态能带或磁性交换模型。
core_items.related_work: 该方向与SchNet、DimeNet、NequIP、MACE等几何等变势形成对照：后者通过局域原子邻域近似电子效应，OrbGNN试图直接注入波函数层面的电子相关信息。它也呼应量子化学中的orbital-free表示、密度矩阵学习与Delta-learning；对于团队中做铁电极化、过渡金属氧化物轨道序、强关联磁性或电子结构机器学习的成员，关键吸引力是让轨道占据而非仅原子坐标成为显式变量。相较MOF通用势，该方法可能更适合处理成键改变、电荷转移与自旋态切换，但计算输入成本也更高。
core_items.implication: 团队可先在小规模基准上测试，而非直接替代现有势：选择BaTiO3极化翻转、CrI3层间磁序、NdNiO3/NdMnO3界面电荷转移三类构型，以DFT+U或混合泛函导出波函数、投影密度矩阵、Wannier哈密顿量和原子力。将这些电子特征与坐标等变图网络并行输入，比较仅几何模型、Delta-learning和OrbGNN式模型在能量、力、带隙、Born有效电荷及交换常数上的外推误差。验证需采用按畸变路径、材料体系和自旋序分组的留出集，并检查预测力是否守恒、预测极化是否满足Berry-phase计算结果。

core_items.title_en: Interplay between crystal structure and magnetism in CeCrB₄
core_items.title_zh: CeCrB₄ 中晶体结构与磁性的相互作用
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2608.28238v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: CeCrB₄ belongs to the family of MTB₄ ternary metal borides, some of whose magnetic phases have recently been identified as quantum spin dimers. Employing density functional theory within the GGA+U framework, this work investigates the key ground-state properties of this system, including its ferromagnetic ground state, the mixed-valence nature of cerium, and the charge transfer from the cationic cerium--chromium layers to the anionic boron layers. In particular, we focus on elucidating the bonding mechanism within the structurally embedded Cr-Cr dimers. Specifically, we evaluate a previously proposed interpretation that the localized Cr 3dz^₂ states are molecular-like bonding and antibonding states. The calculated dependence of the 3dz^₂ electronic structure on the intra-dimer distance correlates with the level-splitting characteristics known for classical homonuclear diatomic molecules.
core_items.abstract_zh: 本文采用 GGA+U 密度泛函理论研究 CeCrB₄ 的基态性质，包括铁磁基态、铈的混合价特征以及从阳离子铈-铬层向阴离子硼层的电荷转移。研究重点是结构中 Cr-Cr 二聚体的成键机制，并检验局域化 Cr 3dₓ²−y²? 原文为 3d_z² 态是否可解释为分子型成键态和反键态。计算显示，3d_z² 电子结构随二聚体内距离的变化，与经典同核双原子分子已知的能级分裂特征相符。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: CeCrB₄ 属于 MTB₄ 三元金属硼化物家族，该家族中的一些磁性相最近被确定为量子自旋二聚体。本文在 GGA+U 框架下采用密度泛函理论，研究了该体系的关键基态性质，包括其铁磁基态、铈的混合价性质，以及从阳离子铈-铬层向阴离子硼层的电荷转移。特别地，我们着重阐明结构中嵌入的 Cr-Cr 二聚体内部的成键机制。具体而言，我们评估了此前提出的一种解释，即局域化的 Cr 3d_z² 态是分子型成键态和反键态。计算得到的 3d_z² 电子结构对二聚体内距离的依赖关系，与经典同核双原子分子中已知的能级分裂特征相吻合。
core_items.summary: 本文采用 GGA+U 密度泛函理论研究 CeCrB₄ 的基态性质，包括铁磁基态、铈的混合价特征以及从阳离子铈-铬层向阴离子硼层的电荷转移。研究重点是结构中 Cr-Cr 二聚体的成键机制，并检验局域化 Cr 3dₓ²−y²? 原文为 3d_z² 态是否可解释为分子型成键态和反键态。计算显示，3d_z² 电子结构随二聚体内距离的变化，与经典同核双原子分子已知的能级分裂特征相符。
authors: Mirosław Werwiński, Andrzej Szajek, Andrzej Kowalczyk
core_items.focus_summary: 该工作采用GGA+U研究CeCrB₄的晶体结构、铁磁基态、铈混合价态及层间电荷转移。作者着重分析Cr-Cr二聚体中Cr 3dz²态的成键和反键分裂，并考察其随二聚体距离的变化。
core_items.focus_relation: 该研究与团队的第一性原理磁性材料、强关联电子结构和自旋相互作用研究相关。对局域轨道成键、结构畸变与磁性的联动分析，可为构建有效自旋或电子模型提供参考。
core_items.focus_suggestion: 可进一步关注不同U值、磁构型和自旋轨道耦合对结论的稳健性，并提取交换参数以连接至自旋哈密顿量。对于混合价特征明显的体系，可考虑采用更高精度的杂化泛函或动力学平均场方法交叉验证。
core_items.method_point: 该工作用GGA+U研究CeCrB4的铁磁基态、Ce混合价、电荷从Ce-Cr阳离子层向B阴离子层的转移，以及Cr-Cr二聚体成键。作者特别跟踪随二聚体内Cr-Cr距离变化的Cr 3d_z2态，检验其是否呈现同核双原子分子式的成键-反键能级分裂；该结构-轨道扫描是论证二聚体机制的核心。摘要未给出U参数、双计数方案、是否含自旋轨道耦合及竞争磁序能量，因此混合价和磁各向异性的定量强度仍需由原文计算细节判定。
core_items.related_work: CeCrB4连接稀土混合价、过渡金属二聚化和硼化物磁性的三个经典问题，与Ce基重费米子化合物及Cr链/二聚体材料中“结构调控局域轨道”的研究相呼应。它与团队中做DFT+U电子关联、磁性硼化物、局域轨道投影和结构相变的方向相合，也可与ML势研究形成互补：ML负责扫描应变和有限温结构，DFT+U负责给出可靠轨道标签。相较二维CrI3等范德瓦耳斯磁体，此体系的交换路径受共价Cr-Cr和B网络共同控制，不能只以原子间距拟合磁性。
core_items.implication: 可围绕CeCrB4建立Cr-Cr二聚体长度、体积应变、单轴应变和Ce价态初值的DFT+U数据集，保存投影态密度、Wannier跃迁、Bader电荷、局域磁矩和多磁序能量。采用多任务模型预测结构到成键-反键分裂、交换参数及磁矩，并以不确定度选择极端二聚化构型回补DFT；对Ce 4f敏感构型加入SOC及不同U的包络标签。验证可比较计算晶格常数、磁化强度、压力下谱峰位移与XRD、磁化率、XAS或ARPES数据，并确认模型未把价态变化误拟合为连续几何效应。

core_items.title_en: Ab initio Modeling of MoS2/Oxide Device Interfaces with Machine Learned Electronic Structures
core_items.title_zh: 利用机器学习电子结构对MoS2/氧化物器件界面进行第一性原理建模
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2608.27533v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a new ab initio approach to simulate semiconductor devices that integrates scalable machine-learned (ML) electronic structure models with an advanced quantum transport (QT) solver. The developed framework enables 10,000X speedups over density functional theory to produce the Hamiltonian matrix of devices made of >20,000 atoms, while offering high prediction accuracy. We use its unique features to investigate MoS2/oxide samples and single-layer MoS2 field-effect transistors, where the surrounding oxide layers, here, HfO2 or Al2O3, are explicitly included into the QT domain. In particular, we reveal that the presence of undercoordinated metal atoms (Hf or Al) close to the semiconductor-oxide interface significantly affects the magnitude of the electronic current and its propagation through MoS2.

core_items.title_en: Interstitials as a key ingredient for P segregation to grain boundaries in polycrystalline α-Fe
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：Interstitials as a key ingredient for P segregation to grain boundaries in polycrystalline α-Fe
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2502.17050v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Solute segregation to grain boundaries (GBs) significantly impacts material behavior, with most studies focusing on substitutional solute segregation while neglecting interstitial segregation due to its increased complexity. The site preference, interstitial or substitutional, for P segregation in α-Fe still remains under debate. This work investigates both substitutional and interstitial GB segregation in a polycrystalline model using classical interatomic potentials and machine learning. The method is validated with H and Ni, whose segregation behaviors are well understood. For P, we find segregation to both GB site types, with a preference for substitutional sites based on mean segregation energy. However, the abundance of interstitial sites means interstitial segregation also significantly contributes to the GB enrichment with P. This highlights the importance of considering interstitial P segregation alongside substitutional segregation. Additionally, obtaining a representative spectrum of segregation energies is crucial for accurate, experimentally aligned predictions.

core_items.focus_summary: 该工作研究多晶 α-Fe 中磷在晶界的替位和间隙偏聚，并以氢和镍的已知偏聚行为验证计算方法。结果发现，磷平均而言更偏好替位晶界位点，但大量间隙位点的存在使间隙偏聚同样对总晶界富集具有重要贡献。
core_items.focus_relation: 与团队的缺陷物理、机器学习原子间势和材料结构-性能关系研究相关。其对缺陷构型统计分布而非仅比较单一最低能构型的处理，也可借鉴到半导体缺陷、晶界及铁电疲劳问题。
core_items.focus_suggestion: 可关注经典势与机器学习模型对磷间隙构型、迁移势垒和晶界化学环境的精度差异。若用于功能材料，可进一步引入有限温度扩散、应力和外电场，研究偏聚对磁性、导电性或失效行为的影响。
core_items.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对《Interstitials as a key ingredient for P segregation to grain boundaries in polycrystalline α-Fe》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_direction_note: 本日的实质推进集中在把机器学习从势能面扩展到可直接服务器件与缺陷问题的电子结构：MoS2/氧化物界面以机器学习哈密顿量耦合量子输运，将大尺寸器件计算推进到两万原子量级；α-Fe/Fe3C界面与α-Fe晶界则以DFT标定的MLIP处理半相干界面和间隙偏聚。uMOF以85,524个DFT构型训练通用势，并把吸附焓、等温线等远离近平衡态的验证作为核心目标，而非仅比较晶格常数。磁性凝聚态方面，MCl3二维三氯化物、NdNiO3/NdMnO3超晶格和CeCrB4分别显示杂化泛函、DFT+U与谱学约束仍是判定交换、轨道重构和混合价的必要基线。

summaries.abstract: arXiv:2608.27533v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a new ab initio approach to simulate semiconductor devices that integrates scalable machine-learned (ML) electronic structure models with an advanced quantum transport (QT) solver. The developed framework enables 10,000X speedups over density functional theory to produce the Hamiltonian matrix of devices made of >20,000 atoms, while offering high prediction accuracy. We use its unique features to investigate MoS2/oxide samples and single-layer MoS2 field-effect transistors, where the surrounding oxide layers, here, HfO2 or Al2O3, are explicitly included into the QT domain. In particular, we reveal that the presence of undercoordinated metal atoms (Hf or Al) close to the semiconductor-oxide interface significantly affects the magnitude of the electronic current and its propagation through MoS2.

summaries.title_en: Electronic structure, magnetic interactions, and magnonics of 2D trichloride materials
summaries.title_zh: 文献研究：Electronic structure, magnetic interactions, and magnonics of 2D trichloride materials
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2608.27747v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Using advanced density functional theory, this study demonstrates the robust thermodynamic, structural, and dynamical stability of pristine, 3d-doped (Ti, Cr), and 4f-doped (Ce) transition metal trichlorides (MCl3). While standard generalized gradient approximation (GGA) incorrectly predicts metallic behavior, hybrid functional calculations successfully capture their semiconducting nature, yielding accurate band gaps of 2.54 eV (VCl3), 4.01 eV (CrCl3), and 2.61 eV (TiCl3). These materials exhibit intrinsic ferromagnetism, with CrCl3 displaying overlapping topological features in both its magnon and phonon dispersions along the high-symmetry K direction, which induces magnon-phonon coupling. Incorporating 3d dopants into VCl3 successfully tunes the bandgap (1.32 eV for Ti and 2.74 eV for Cr) without destroying ferromagnetism, while 4f Ce-doping in CrCl3 introduces localized states below the Fermi level that yield strong nearest-neighbor exchange coupling. Ultimately, this electronic and magnetic tunability highlights the potential of these 2D trichlorides in advanced spintronic functionalities.

authors: Krishna Prasad Chapai, Yogendra Limbu, Gopi Chandra Kaphle, Durga Paudyal
summaries.focus_summary: 该研究基于密度泛函理论和杂化泛函计算二维三氯化物的结构稳定性、电子结构、磁性及磁振子性质，并研究Ti、Cr和Ce掺杂对带隙和交换作用的调控。结果显示这些材料具有本征铁磁性，CrCl3中还存在磁振子-声子耦合及潜在拓扑特征。
summaries.focus_relation: 与我们的二维范德华磁体、磁性材料、非共线磁性、自旋哈密顿量、磁振子-声子耦合和自旋电子学方向直接相关。其掺杂调控电子结构与交换相互作用的方法，可用于发展二维磁性材料设计和自旋输运研究。
summaries.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步计算不同磁构型下的交换参数、磁各向异性、Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用和有限温度磁相变，并构建自旋哈密顿量结合蒙特卡洛模拟。还可使用声子与磁振子谱、非绝热动力学或自旋-晶格动力学定量研究磁振子-声子耦合及磁阻尼。
summaries.method_point: 该文以先进DFT考察二维MCl3三氯化物的本征、Ti/Cr等3d掺杂及Ce等4f掺杂情形，依次判定热力学、结构和动力学稳定性，并计算电子结构、磁相互作用和磁振子性质。其明确技术结论是常规GGA错误给出金属性，而杂化泛函恢复正确的绝缘电子结构；随后应从不同自旋构型能量映射交换参数，并以此求解自旋波，但摘要未列出具体杂化比例、U值、k网格、超胞和磁振子求解器。这里的可靠性瓶颈是带隙与交换常数对交换关联处理的敏感性。
summaries.related_work: 该研究与CrI3、CrGeTe3、CrSBr等二维范德瓦耳斯磁体的“电子关联-各向异性-磁振子”研究同源，但将卤化物骨架及3d/4f掺杂作为调控维度。它提示只用GGA或固定经验U来训练磁性数据库可能把绝缘磁体误标为金属；这与团队中从事二维磁性、DFT+U/杂化泛函标定、磁振子模型及机器学习交换参数拟合的方向直接相关。与CrI3中自旋轨道耦合主导的各向异性相比，4f掺杂还会引入更局域且多重态复杂的磁性来源。
summaries.implication: 可选取团队已有CrI3、CrSBr及候选MCl3单层，统一生成应变、缺陷、掺杂浓度和多自旋序构型；用少量HSE或经标定的DFT+U计算作为高保真标签，GGA数据仅作预训练。以equivariant GNN学习局域结构到自旋构型能、磁矩和交换张量的映射，再在大超胞上进行经典蒙特卡洛和线性自旋波计算，扫描居里温度及磁振子带隙。应以HSE复算带隙、以不同磁序能差复算J，并用Raman、MOKE或非弹性散射可获得的声子和磁振子特征交叉验证。

summaries.title_en: Band-like Carriers in a Soft, Anharmonic Lattice: Lead-Halide Perovskites
summaries.title_zh: 软非谐晶格中的能带型载流子：卤化铅钙钛矿
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2608.28104v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lead-halide perovskites APbX3 present a striking dichotomy: they exhibit band-like electronic transport despite their exceptionally soft and anharmonic lattices. Optically and electrically, they resemble conventional direct-gap semiconductors, exhibiting light carrier masses and steep absorption onsets, whereas their lattices display liquid-like dynamics, including overdamped octahedral motions, quasielastic Raman central peaks, and exceptionally low thermal conductivities. Solution-processed films nevertheless sustain micrometre-scale carrier diffusion at defect densities that would severely suppress transport in conventional semiconductors. Here, we argue that these apparently disparate properties emerge from a common microscopic framework: a soft, strongly anharmonic, and polar [PbX3]- framework, strongly influenced by the Pb 6s2 lone pair, which simultaneously shapes the antibonding orbital character of the band edges, the magnitude and multiple timescales of the dielectric response, and the slow relaxational dynamics that dress every charge carrier. We therefore invert the conventional order and develop the lattice before the electronic structure, because the nominally cubic phase is better viewed as a thermally fluctuating ensemble of locally symmetry-broken configurations rather than a single geometry. Within this framework, we discuss excitons, Frohlich large polarons in the intermediate-coupling regime, carrier transport, defect tolerance, dimensional reduction in two-dimensional and nanocrystalline derivatives, and symmetry-breaking phenomena. We critically assess three contested issues - defect tolerance, ferroelectricity, and the interpretation of the T-3/2 mobility law - and identify seven open questions together with the key measurements needed to resolve them
summaries.abstract_zh: 卤化铅钙钛矿APbX3具有显著矛盾性：其晶格极软且强非谐，却表现出能带型电子输运和较长的载流子扩散距离。本文提出统一微观图像，认为受Pb 6s2孤对电子强烈影响的软、强非谐且极性的[PbX3]-骨架，同时决定带边反键轨道、介电响应与载流子弛豫动力学。文章据此讨论激子、大Fröhlich极化子、输运、缺陷容忍性及对称性破缺，并评估若干争议问题和开放问题。
summaries.abstract_zh_full: 卤化铅钙钛矿APbX3呈现出显著的二分性：尽管其晶格异常柔软且高度非谐，却表现出能带型电子输运。在光学和电学性质上，它们类似于传统直接带隙半导体，表现出较轻的载流子有效质量和陡峭的吸收边；而其晶格却呈现液体般的动力学，包括过阻尼八面体运动、准弹性拉曼中心峰和异常低的热导率。尽管缺陷密度在传统半导体中会严重抑制输运，溶液法制备的薄膜仍可维持微米尺度的载流子扩散。本文认为，这些表面上彼此割裂的性质源于一个共同的微观框架：柔软、强非谐且具有极性的[PbX3]-骨架受到Pb 6s2孤对电子的强烈影响，并同时塑造带边的反键轨道特征、介电响应的幅度与多个时间尺度，以及修饰每个电荷载流子的缓慢弛豫动力学。因此，我们颠倒了通常的论述顺序，先讨论晶格后讨论电子结构，因为名义上的立方相更适合被看作局域对称性破缺构型的热涨落系综，而非单一几何构型。在这一框架内，我们讨论了激子、中等耦合区间的Fröhlich大极化子、载流子输运、缺陷容忍性、二维和纳米晶衍生物中的维度降低，以及对称性破缺现象。我们批判性评估了三个有争议的问题，即缺陷容忍性、铁电性和T⁻³/2迁移率定律的解释，并确定了七个开放问题及解决它们所需的关键测量。
summaries.summary: 卤化铅钙钛矿APbX3具有显著矛盾性：其晶格极软且强非谐，却表现出能带型电子输运和较长的载流子扩散距离。本文提出统一微观图像，认为受Pb 6s2孤对电子强烈影响的软、强非谐且极性的[PbX3]-骨架，同时决定带边反键轨道、介电响应与载流子弛豫动力学。文章据此讨论激子、大Fröhlich极化子、输运、缺陷容忍性及对称性破缺，并评估若干争议问题和开放问题。
authors: Young Mi Lee, Inhee Maeng, Jinwoo Park, Seung-Jae Oh, Min-Cherl Jung
summaries.focus_summary: 论文研究铅卤钙钛矿中带状载流子输运与软性、强非谐极性晶格之间的关系。主要结论是，Pb 6s2 孤对电子塑造了能带边、介电响应和晶格弛豫动力学，从而使材料在低热导和强晶格涨落下仍保持较好的载流子扩散与输运特性。
summaries.focus_relation: 与我们的卤化物钙钛矿、载流子输运、电子-声子耦合、热载流子弛豫和非绝热动力学方向高度相关。其关于强非谐晶格、极化屏蔽和载流子-晶格耦合的统一图像，可为第一性原理分子动力学、声子重整化及输运计算提供参考。
summaries.focus_suggestion: 可进一步结合非绝热分子动力学或电子-声子耦合计算，定量研究软晶格对迁移率、载流子寿命和热载流子弛豫的影响。也可利用机器学习势扩展到有限温度、大尺度和含缺陷体系。
summaries.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
summaries.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
summaries.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《软非谐晶格中的能带型载流子：卤化铅钙钛矿》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

summaries.title_en: Dilute-Limit Defect Displacements Enabled by Brillouin-Zone Sampling
summaries.title_zh: 文献研究：Dilute-Limit Defect Displacements Enabled by Brillouin-Zone Sampling
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2608.27722v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Defects and their interaction with the semiconductor host lattice play an essential role in a variety of technologies. When a defect transitions between two electronic states, the lattice distorts in response. Large displacements occur near the defect, inducing displacements on neighboring atoms, and so on, producing small displacements on atoms hundreds of Ångströms from the defect. Describing these displacements accurately is challenging for first-principles calculations due to limited supercell sizes. Here we demonstrate a procedure to efficiently obtain dilute-limit atomic displacements, using information obtained in typical modest supercells. In our approach, the atomic displacements are first obtained in a small supercell and converted into a force difference under a harmonic potential energy surface. The force difference and phonon modes at different bf q-points are then unfolded into the Born-von Kármán supercell to obtain the dilute-limit atomic displacements. We critically analyze the convergence behavior of the force difference and study possible electron density differences that give rise to those forces, arguing that modest supercells are sufficient for internal transitions and bound-exciton transitions. Two example applications of our approach are given: (1) we calculate the luminescence spectrum of the NV center in diamond and the T center in Si and (2) we obtain dilute-limit configuration coordinate diagrams for these defects. In particular, we find that coupling to acoustic phonon modes reduces the accepting-mode frequency in the configuration coordinate diagram. Our work provides the missing ingredients necessary to address truly dilute-limit transitions at defects.

authors: Mark E. Turiansky, John L. Lyons, Noam Bernstein
summaries.focus_summary: 该工作提出利用布里渊区采样从常规小超胞推断稀释极限缺陷原子位移的方法。该方法先将小超胞位移转换为谐和势能面下的力差，再借助不同 q 点的声子模展开到 Born-von Karman 超胞，从而描述缺陷诱导的远程晶格弛豫。
summaries.focus_relation: 该工作与团队的半导体缺陷、缺陷形成能与电荷态、声子及第一性原理计算方向直接相关。它尤其有助于降低有限超胞误差，改进带电缺陷结构弛豫、电子-声子耦合和载流子俘获计算的可靠性。
summaries.focus_suggestion: 建议评估该方法在 SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿等团队关注体系的带电缺陷、软模和长程极化响应中的适用性。可将稀释极限结构与缺陷电荷修正、非辐射复合构型坐标及机器学习哈密顿量结合。
summaries.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：第一性原理标注与结构优化，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
summaries.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
summaries.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Dilute-Limit Defect Displacements Enabled by Brillouin-Zone Sampling》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

summaries.title_en: Emergent chiral symmetry breaking in moiré domain walls redirects topological boundary states in graphene
summaries.title_zh: 文献研究：Emergent chiral symmetry breaking in moiré domain walls redirects topological boundary states in graphene
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2602.23570v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Stacking two sheets of graphene with a slight twist or lattice mismatch produces a moiré pattern that self-organizes into a network of one-dimensional channels, or domain walls, known to conduct electrons with low dissipation - a property attractive for low-power electronics. We show that these channels are not always straight: as the graphene lattice relaxes to minimize strain, the network can spontaneously curve into chiral configurations. Using atomistic simulations, we map a phase diagram in which the local balance of strain and flexibility selects one of three stable shapes-straight, mono-chiral, or dual-chiral, curving to one or both sides. Electronic structure calculations show that this geometric choice controls where low-energy electrons accumulate. Straight channels concentrate electronic states at points where differently stacked regions meet, with balanced conduction on both sides of a domain wall. Chiral channels instead redirect that electronic weight onto the domain walls themselves, favouring one side over the other and breaking up the smooth wave patterns seen in straight channels. This purely geometric effect acts as a switch, letting the same moiré material support either localised electronic hot spots or directional one-dimensional conducting channels - two distinct strategies for guiding electrons in future low-power graphene devices.
