authors: Xue Yan, Kaiyun Chen, Yuan Yan, Fan Feng, Minglei Sun, Christian Brandl, Jefferson Zhe Liu
summaries.focus_summary: 该工作研究扭转或失配双层石墨烯中莫尔畴壁网络的结构弛豫与电子态重分布。原子尺度模拟表明，局域应变和柔顺性的竞争可导致直线、单手性或双手性畴壁构型，而手性畴壁会将低能电子态重新导向畴壁并产生侧向不对称。
summaries.focus_relation: 该论文与团队的莫尔材料、二维范德华体系、畴壁、界面拓扑态和第一性原理电子结构研究高度相关。结构弛豫诱导的几何手性与边界态重构，为滑移铁电或范德华异质结构中的畴壁电子学提供了可借鉴机制。
summaries.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步厘清其原子势模型、尺度效应和电子结构计算之间的衔接，并考察外加应变、电场和载流子掺杂的可调控性。可将类似分析推广到具有极化或磁序的莫尔双层体系，探索畴壁处的铁电、谷或自旋响应。
summaries.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
summaries.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
summaries.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Emergent chiral symmetry breaking in moiré domain walls redirects topological boundary states in graphene》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

summaries.title_en: DFT and MLIP study of solute segregation to coherent and semi-coherent α-Fe/Fe₃C interfaces
summaries.title_zh: 文献研究：DFT and MLIP study of solute segregation to coherent and semi-coherent α-Fe/Fe₃C interfaces
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2602.14603v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Solute segregation to interfaces significantly impacts material behavior. A large majority of theoretical works focus on grain boundaries and coherent interfaces. Studies on semi-coherent interfaces are usually prohibited by the structural complexity, yielding models beyond the practical capability of density functional theory (DFT), or chemical complexity, restricted by the availability of (classical) interatomic potentials. This work investigates solute segregation to the coherent and semi-coherent α-Fe/Fe₃C interface in pearlite and its effect on mechanical properties using novel universal machine learning interatomic potentials (uMLIPs). DFT calculated solution enthalpies, segregation energetics, and changes in cohesion at the coherent interface are used to benchmark several state-of-the-art uMLIPs. We find that the GRACE-2L-OAM and GRACE-2L-OMAT models most accurately reproduce the quantum-mechanical predictions. While Cu has the strongest segregation energy of approx -0.3 eV to the coherent interface among the investigated tramp and trace elements, all of them, As, Cr, Cu, Mo, Ni, P, Sb, and Sn, exhibit significantly more negative segregation values reaching below approx -1.5 eV in the presence of the misfit dislocation at the semi-coherent interface. The deepest traps are identified in the vicinity of the dislocation core, although the spatial distribution of segregation energies differs markedly among the solute species. The cohesion of the coherent interface is strongly reduced by Sb, Sn, P, and As, and only mildly by Cu, whereas Ni shows a negligible effect, and Cr and Mo slightly enhance cohesion. In contrast, all investigated solutes (except for P) tend to embrittle the semi-coherent interface, with Sn and, especially, Sb having the strongest impact in tensile tests performed in the out-of-plane direction. Abstract shortened for ArXiv.
summaries.summary: arXiv:2602.14603v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Solute segregation to interfaces significantly impacts material behavior. A large majority of theoretical works focus on grain boundaries and cohere…
authors: Amin Reiners-Sakic, Ronald Schnitzer, David Holec
summaries.focus_summary: 该工作结合密度泛函理论与通用机器学习原子间势，研究珠光体中相干及半相干α-Fe/Fe₃C界面的溶质偏聚和界面结合行为。作者以DFT的溶解焓、偏聚能和内聚变化为基准评估多种模型，发现GRACE系列模型对量子力学结果的再现较好。
summaries.focus_relation: 与团队的第一性原理计算、机器学习势、磁性材料和界面缺陷相关研究具有较高关联。其以小尺度DFT数据校准通用MLIP、进而处理复杂大尺度界面的流程可供材料缺陷与界面模拟借鉴。
summaries.focus_suggestion: 可重点阅读其针对半相干界面构型和偏聚能的验证方案，并评估等变机器学习势在含磁性自由度铁基界面中的可靠性。可进一步扩展至应力、温度及溶质共偏聚条件下的界面结构演化与力学响应。
summaries.method_point: 该工作以DFT计算作为基准，针对相干及半相干α-Fe/Fe3C界面构建机器学习原子间势，并用其补足半相干界面因失配位错和大超胞而超出常规DFT可承受范围的问题。计算对象包含不同溶质、界面位点及局域结构环境，核心输出是偏聚能及其与界面结构的关联；所给摘要未披露MLIP的具体架构、截断半径、训练集规模或误差指标，因此不能据此断言采用MACE、NEP或equivariant GNN。方法上的关键是以DFT覆盖代表性局域构型，再由势函数对大尺度半相干界面采样。
summaries.related_work: 它直接延续晶界溶质偏聚的DFT与经典势研究，但将研究重点由理想晶界、相干界面推进到含失配位错网络的α-Fe/Fe3C半相干界面。与仅拟合体相弹性或点缺陷的MLIP不同，训练分布必须同时覆盖bcc Fe、Fe3C、界面低配位原子、应变和不同化学组分；这与团队中从事铁磁金属缺陷、原子尺度势函数、相场或力学耦合的研究线可直接衔接。它也与第8篇的P晶界偏聚形成互补：前者问相界，后者问晶界间隙占位。
summaries.implication: 可先以团队已有α-Fe、Fe3C及P、C、Mn、Si等元素的DFT数据库建立主动学习池，显式加入不同取向关系、失配位错核心、界面间距和溶质浓度的超胞。训练时将偏聚能差、原子力和应力共同纳入保留集，随后在10^4至10^5原子半相干界面上进行NPT退火与MC/MD溶质交换采样，得到温度依赖的位点占据率。验证应回算高不确定度位点的DFT偏聚能，并将预测的富集位置与APT、TEM-EDS或已发表界面偏聚趋势比较。

summaries.title_en: Charge transfer and competing symmetry breaking drive orbital reconstruction and emergent ferromagnetism in insulating oxide superlattices
summaries.title_zh: 电荷转移与竞争性对称性破缺驱动绝缘氧化物超晶格中的轨道重构和涌现铁磁性
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2608.28107v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electron correlation, hopping, and ligand-to-metal charge transfer collectively lead to diverse electronic and magnetic phenomena in 3d transition-metal oxides, where directional d orbitals make hopping highly sensitive to symmetry-dependent orbital overlap. Heterostructure engineering with atomically flat interfaces adds symmetry-breaking charge transfer as a further route to emergent behavior, yet whether interfacial mismatch between constituent oxides of a superlattice shapes ground states independent of epitaxial strain remains unresolved. Here we examine superlattices combining NdNiO₃ with Mott-insulating NdMnO₃. Varying layer thickness and combining transport with X-ray spectroscopy, we show that electron transfer from NdMnO₃ to NdNiO₃ drives a room-temperature insulating state with a distinct electronic structure, accompanied by a reversal in orbital symmetry beyond simple strain considerations, underscoring the interface's central role. These reconstructions stabilize an emergent ferromagnetic insulating state arising from interfacial Ni²⁺-O-Mn⁴⁺ superexchange. Our results establish a pathway to interface-engineered ferromagnetic insulating phases via competing interactions, with potential for spin-insulatronic applications.
summaries.abstract_zh: 本文研究NdNiO3与Mott绝缘体NdMnO3构成的超晶格，考察界面电荷转移和对称性破缺对基态的作用。调节层厚并结合输运和X射线谱学发现，从NdMnO3至NdNiO3的电子转移驱动室温绝缘态，并导致不能仅以外延应变解释的轨道对称性反转。界面Ni2+-O-Mn4+超交换由此稳定涌现的铁磁绝缘态，为界面工程化铁磁绝缘相及自旋绝缘电子学应用提供了路径。
summaries.abstract_zh_full: 电子关联、跃迁以及配体至金属的电荷转移共同导致3d过渡金属氧化物中多样的电子和磁性现象；在这些材料中，具有方向性的d轨道使跃迁对依赖对称性的轨道重叠高度敏感。具有原子级平整界面的异质结构工程，将由对称性破缺引起的电荷转移作为获得涌现行为的另一条途径；然而，超晶格组分氧化物之间的界面失配是否能独立于外延应变而塑造基态，仍未得到解决。本文考察了结合NdNiO3和Mott绝缘体NdMnO3的超晶格。通过改变层厚度并结合输运测量与X射线谱学，我们表明，从NdMnO3向NdNiO3的电子转移驱动了室温绝缘态及其独特电子结构，同时伴随超出简单应变考量的轨道对称性反转，凸显了界面的核心作用。这些重构稳定了一种涌现的铁磁绝缘态，该态源于界面Ni2+-O-Mn4+超交换。我们的结果确立了通过竞争相互作用获得界面工程化铁磁绝缘相的路径，并有望应用于自旋绝缘电子学。
summaries.summary: 本文研究NdNiO3与Mott绝缘体NdMnO3构成的超晶格，考察界面电荷转移和对称性破缺对基态的作用。调节层厚并结合输运和X射线谱学发现，从NdMnO3至NdNiO3的电子转移驱动室温绝缘态，并导致不能仅以外延应变解释的轨道对称性反转。界面Ni2+-O-Mn4+超交换由此稳定涌现的铁磁绝缘态，为界面工程化铁磁绝缘相及自旋绝缘电子学应用提供了路径。
authors: Nandana Bhattacharya, Ranjan Kumar Patel, Siddharth Kumar, Sourav Chowdhury, Manav Beniwal, Suresh Chandra Joshi, Prithwijit Mandal, Jayjit Kumar Dey, Weibin Li, Manuel Valvidares, Zhan Zhang, Hua Zhou, Andrei Gloskovskii, Christoph Schlueter, Christoph Klewe, Srimanta Middey
summaries.focus_summary: 论文研究 NdNiO3/NdMnO3 氧化物超晶格中的界面电荷转移、轨道重构和对称性破缺。研究发现，NdMnO3 向 NdNiO3 的电子转移可形成室温绝缘态，并通过 Ni2+-O-Mn4+ 超交换稳定界面诱导的铁磁绝缘态。
summaries.focus_relation: 与我们的磁性材料、磁性超晶格、界面电荷转移、轨道重构和自旋相关相互作用方向相关。虽然工作以实验表征为主，但其界面诱导磁性和超交换机制适合用第一性原理、有效自旋哈密顿量及蒙特卡洛方法进一步解析。
summaries.focus_suggestion: 建议开展不同层厚、应变和界面终止条件下的第一性原理计算，分离电荷转移、晶格失配与应变对磁基态的贡献。还可提取交换参数和磁各向异性，研究温度依赖的界面磁序。
summaries.method_point: 该文通过改变NdNiO3/NdMnO3超晶格层厚，结合电输运与X射线谱学，分离界面电荷转移、外延应变和竞争性对称性破缺对基态的贡献。实验指出电子由NdMnO3转移至NdNiO3，形成室温绝缘态并引起不能由应变单独解释的轨道对称性反转；界面Ni2+-O-Mn4+超交换稳定铁磁绝缘相。摘要没有报告机器学习模型或具体第一性原理设置，因此其ML关联应定位为可供结构-谱学联合学习的高价值界面基准，而非已完成的ML预测。
summaries.related_work: 这与LaNiO3/LaMnO3、LaAlO3/SrTiO3等氧化物异质结中电荷转移、轨道极化和界面磁性的研究呼应，但NdNiO3本身的金属-绝缘体转变和NdMnO3的Mott关联使层厚依赖更难由简单能带对齐解释。它可连接团队中从事钙钛矿铁电、氧化物磁性界面、DFT+U/DMFT及XAS解析的研究线；若团队已有BaTiO3或极性氧化物平台，还可比较极化电场与化学电荷转移两种界面控制量。与纯应变工程不同，文中强调轨道重构必须显式处理价态变化。
summaries.implication: 可围绕(NdNiO3)m/(NdMnO3)n建立层厚、终止面、氧八面体转角和应变的结构库，使用DFT+U并以XAS/XLD约束Ni、Mn价态和轨道占据；对关键构型用DMFT或混合泛函做校准。随后以图网络或高斯过程学习结构描述符到电荷转移、交换符号和绝缘隙的映射，在未计算层厚上做贝叶斯优化。实验验证应制备同一应变基底上的厚度楔形样品，联测输运、XMCD、XLD和STEM-EELS，并与模型预测的界面价态剖面对照。

summaries.title_en: OrbGNN: A Wave function-based Machine Learning Interelectronic Representation
summaries.title_zh: 文献研究：OrbGNN: A Wave function-based Machine Learning Interelectronic Representation
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2608.27806v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have become emerging tools in molecular modeling and computational chemistry. By learning high-dimensional potential energy surfaces from quantum chemical data, MLIPs enable accurate and efficient predictions of structural, thermodynamic, and dynamical properties. However, such models have limitations in predictions of electronic properties and the effects of static electron correlation due to their lack of electronic structure information. This work presents OrbGNN, an electronic structure graph architecture analogous to molecular graph and MLIP frameworks, where pair-orbital interactions constitute the graph representation, while orbital entanglement encodes the connectivity between them. By embedding information derived from orbital correlation metrics directly into the graph topology, OrbGNN provides a compact representation of a molecule s orbital landscape and electron correlation patterns. Analysis of the behavior of the feature space in an orbital graph are shown to demonstrate model robustness. The model is evaluated for the dissociation of nitrogen and for a larger dataset of diatomic molecules. Finally, the OrbGNN model is applied to a set of octahedral iron(II) complexes to predict spin-state energy gaps.
summaries.summary: arXiv:2608.27806v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have become emerging tools in molecular modeling and computational chemistry. By learning high-dimension…
authors: Brody Quebedeaux, Shahzad Akram, Markus Reiher, Konstantinos D. Vogiatzis
summaries.focus_summary: 该工作提出OrbGNN，以成对轨道相互作用构建图结构，并将轨道纠缠和电子关联信息嵌入图连接关系。模型在氮分子解离等电子关联问题上用于表征轨道空间及其特征鲁棒性。
summaries.focus_relation: 该方向与团队发展的图神经网络、等变神经网络以及机器学习电子结构和Kohn-Sham哈密顿量存在方法学关联。其显式引入轨道关联信息的表示方式，对面向强关联材料的电子哈密顿量学习有启发。
summaries.focus_suggestion: 建议评估该表示能否从分子体系推广至周期性固体、能带和局域轨道基下的材料问题。可进一步比较其与Wannier轨道哈密顿量学习、密度矩阵预测方法在缺陷和磁性体系中的数据效率与可解释性。
summaries.method_point: OrbGNN提出以波函数为基础的机器学习“电子间表示”，目标是突破常规MLIP主要依赖原子种类、距离和局域几何描述符的限制。按摘要可知，它将量子化学波函数所含电子结构信息编码进图模型，用于学习高维势能面及结构、热力学和动力学性质；但摘要截断，未给出节点和边特征是否来自轨道系数、密度矩阵或双电子积分，也未给出网络层数、训练目标及数据集。因而不能把它误述为已验证的凝聚态能带或磁性交换模型。
summaries.related_work: 该方向与SchNet、DimeNet、NequIP、MACE等几何等变势形成对照：后者通过局域原子邻域近似电子效应，OrbGNN试图直接注入波函数层面的电子相关信息。它也呼应量子化学中的orbital-free表示、密度矩阵学习与Delta-learning；对于团队中做铁电极化、过渡金属氧化物轨道序、强关联磁性或电子结构机器学习的成员，关键吸引力是让轨道占据而非仅原子坐标成为显式变量。相较MOF通用势，该方法可能更适合处理成键改变、电荷转移与自旋态切换，但计算输入成本也更高。
summaries.implication: 团队可先在小规模基准上测试，而非直接替代现有势：选择BaTiO3极化翻转、CrI3层间磁序、NdNiO3/NdMnO3界面电荷转移三类构型，以DFT+U或混合泛函导出波函数、投影密度矩阵、Wannier哈密顿量和原子力。将这些电子特征与坐标等变图网络并行输入，比较仅几何模型、Delta-learning和OrbGNN式模型在能量、力、带隙、Born有效电荷及交换常数上的外推误差。验证需采用按畸变路径、材料体系和自旋序分组的留出集，并检查预测力是否守恒、预测极化是否满足Berry-phase计算结果。

summaries.title_en: Interplay between crystal structure and magnetism in CeCrB₄
summaries.title_zh: CeCrB₄ 中晶体结构与磁性的相互作用
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2608.28238v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: CeCrB₄ belongs to the family of MTB₄ ternary metal borides, some of whose magnetic phases have recently been identified as quantum spin dimers. Employing density functional theory within the GGA+U framework, this work investigates the key ground-state properties of this system, including its ferromagnetic ground state, the mixed-valence nature of cerium, and the charge transfer from the cationic cerium--chromium layers to the anionic boron layers. In particular, we focus on elucidating the bonding mechanism within the structurally embedded Cr-Cr dimers. Specifically, we evaluate a previously proposed interpretation that the localized Cr 3dz^₂ states are molecular-like bonding and antibonding states. The calculated dependence of the 3dz^₂ electronic structure on the intra-dimer distance correlates with the level-splitting characteristics known for classical homonuclear diatomic molecules.
summaries.abstract_zh: 本文采用 GGA+U 密度泛函理论研究 CeCrB₄ 的基态性质，包括铁磁基态、铈的混合价特征以及从阳离子铈-铬层向阴离子硼层的电荷转移。研究重点是结构中 Cr-Cr 二聚体的成键机制，并检验局域化 Cr 3dₓ²−y²? 原文为 3d_z² 态是否可解释为分子型成键态和反键态。计算显示，3d_z² 电子结构随二聚体内距离的变化，与经典同核双原子分子已知的能级分裂特征相符。
summaries.abstract_zh_full: CeCrB₄ 属于 MTB₄ 三元金属硼化物家族，该家族中的一些磁性相最近被确定为量子自旋二聚体。本文在 GGA+U 框架下采用密度泛函理论，研究了该体系的关键基态性质，包括其铁磁基态、铈的混合价性质，以及从阳离子铈-铬层向阴离子硼层的电荷转移。特别地，我们着重阐明结构中嵌入的 Cr-Cr 二聚体内部的成键机制。具体而言，我们评估了此前提出的一种解释，即局域化的 Cr 3d_z² 态是分子型成键态和反键态。计算得到的 3d_z² 电子结构对二聚体内距离的依赖关系，与经典同核双原子分子中已知的能级分裂特征相吻合。
summaries.summary: 本文采用 GGA+U 密度泛函理论研究 CeCrB₄ 的基态性质，包括铁磁基态、铈的混合价特征以及从阳离子铈-铬层向阴离子硼层的电荷转移。研究重点是结构中 Cr-Cr 二聚体的成键机制，并检验局域化 Cr 3dₓ²−y²? 原文为 3d_z² 态是否可解释为分子型成键态和反键态。计算显示，3d_z² 电子结构随二聚体内距离的变化，与经典同核双原子分子已知的能级分裂特征相符。
authors: Mirosław Werwiński, Andrzej Szajek, Andrzej Kowalczyk
summaries.focus_summary: 该工作采用GGA+U研究CeCrB₄的晶体结构、铁磁基态、铈混合价态及层间电荷转移。作者着重分析Cr-Cr二聚体中Cr 3dz²态的成键和反键分裂，并考察其随二聚体距离的变化。
summaries.focus_relation: 该研究与团队的第一性原理磁性材料、强关联电子结构和自旋相互作用研究相关。对局域轨道成键、结构畸变与磁性的联动分析，可为构建有效自旋或电子模型提供参考。
summaries.focus_suggestion: 可进一步关注不同U值、磁构型和自旋轨道耦合对结论的稳健性，并提取交换参数以连接至自旋哈密顿量。对于混合价特征明显的体系，可考虑采用更高精度的杂化泛函或动力学平均场方法交叉验证。
summaries.method_point: 该工作用GGA+U研究CeCrB4的铁磁基态、Ce混合价、电荷从Ce-Cr阳离子层向B阴离子层的转移，以及Cr-Cr二聚体成键。作者特别跟踪随二聚体内Cr-Cr距离变化的Cr 3d_z2态，检验其是否呈现同核双原子分子式的成键-反键能级分裂；该结构-轨道扫描是论证二聚体机制的核心。摘要未给出U参数、双计数方案、是否含自旋轨道耦合及竞争磁序能量，因此混合价和磁各向异性的定量强度仍需由原文计算细节判定。
summaries.related_work: CeCrB4连接稀土混合价、过渡金属二聚化和硼化物磁性的三个经典问题，与Ce基重费米子化合物及Cr链/二聚体材料中“结构调控局域轨道”的研究相呼应。它与团队中做DFT+U电子关联、磁性硼化物、局域轨道投影和结构相变的方向相合，也可与ML势研究形成互补：ML负责扫描应变和有限温结构，DFT+U负责给出可靠轨道标签。相较二维CrI3等范德瓦耳斯磁体，此体系的交换路径受共价Cr-Cr和B网络共同控制，不能只以原子间距拟合磁性。
summaries.implication: 可围绕CeCrB4建立Cr-Cr二聚体长度、体积应变、单轴应变和Ce价态初值的DFT+U数据集，保存投影态密度、Wannier跃迁、Bader电荷、局域磁矩和多磁序能量。采用多任务模型预测结构到成键-反键分裂、交换参数及磁矩，并以不确定度选择极端二聚化构型回补DFT；对Ce 4f敏感构型加入SOC及不同U的包络标签。验证可比较计算晶格常数、磁化强度、压力下谱峰位移与XRD、磁化率、XAS或ARPES数据，并确认模型未把价态变化误拟合为连续几何效应。

summaries.title_en: Interstitials as a key ingredient for P segregation to grain boundaries in polycrystalline α-Fe
summaries.title_zh: 文献研究：Interstitials as a key ingredient for P segregation to grain boundaries in polycrystalline α-Fe
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2502.17050v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Solute segregation to grain boundaries (GBs) significantly impacts material behavior, with most studies focusing on substitutional solute segregation while neglecting interstitial segregation due to its increased complexity. The site preference, interstitial or substitutional, for P segregation in α-Fe still remains under debate. This work investigates both substitutional and interstitial GB segregation in a polycrystalline model using classical interatomic potentials and machine learning. The method is validated with H and Ni, whose segregation behaviors are well understood. For P, we find segregation to both GB site types, with a preference for substitutional sites based on mean segregation energy. However, the abundance of interstitial sites means interstitial segregation also significantly contributes to the GB enrichment with P. This highlights the importance of considering interstitial P segregation alongside substitutional segregation. Additionally, obtaining a representative spectrum of segregation energies is crucial for accurate, experimentally aligned predictions.

authors: Amin Reiners-Sakic, Alexander Reichmann, Christoph Dösinger, Lorenz Romaner, David Holec
summaries.focus_summary: 该工作研究多晶 α-Fe 中磷在晶界的替位和间隙偏聚，并以氢和镍的已知偏聚行为验证计算方法。结果发现，磷平均而言更偏好替位晶界位点，但大量间隙位点的存在使间隙偏聚同样对总晶界富集具有重要贡献。
summaries.focus_relation: 与团队的缺陷物理、机器学习原子间势和材料结构-性能关系研究相关。其对缺陷构型统计分布而非仅比较单一最低能构型的处理，也可借鉴到半导体缺陷、晶界及铁电疲劳问题。
summaries.focus_suggestion: 可关注经典势与机器学习模型对磷间隙构型、迁移势垒和晶界化学环境的精度差异。若用于功能材料，可进一步引入有限温度扩散、应力和外电场，研究偏聚对磁性、导电性或失效行为的影响。
summaries.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
summaries.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
summaries.implication: 对《Interstitials as a key ingredient for P segregation to grain boundaries in polycrystalline α-Fe》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

summaries.title_en: Stress-induced Martensitic transformation in epitaxial Ni-Mn-Ga thin films and its correlation to optical and magneto-optical properties
summaries.title_zh: 文献研究：Stress-induced Martensitic transformation in epitaxial Ni-Mn-Ga thin films and its correlation to optical and magneto-optical properties
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2507.04907v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The optical and magneto-optical properties of thin epitaxial Ni-Mn-Ga films, with thicknesses ranging from 8 to 160 nm, were investigated across the spectral range of 0.7-6.4 eV. The films were deposited by DC magnetron sputtering on MgO substrate with stress-mediating Cr buffer layer. Structural and magnetic characterization revealed an stress-induced martensitic transformation for the films thicker than 80 nm, while thinner films remained in austenite structure deformed by substrate constraint. Both X-type and Y-type twin domains were observed in martensitic samples. Magneto-optical polar Kerr effect spectra showed notable evolution with film thicknesses, demonstrating changes in electronic structure of Ni-Mn-Ga. A combination of spectroscopic ellipsometry and magneto-optical Kerr spectroscopy allowed for the deduction of the spectral dependence of full permittivity tensor of investigated samples. Three magneto-optical transitions were fitted to the spectra of non-diagonal permittivity using semiclassical theory, showing strong correlations with in-plane coercivity. Observed correlations highlight the impact of substrate-induced strain on Ni-Mn-Ga films and provide insights into the electronic structure changes associated with the martensitic transformation.

authors: M. Makeš, J. Zázvorka, M. Hubert, P. Veřtát, M. Rameš, J. Zemen, O. Heczko, M. Veis
summaries.focus_summary: 该论文研究外延 Ni-Mn-Ga 薄膜中的应力诱导马氏体相变，以及薄膜厚度对结构、磁性、光学和磁光性质的影响。结果表明，较厚薄膜发生马氏体转变并形成孪晶结构，其介电张量和磁光跃迁与面内矫顽力存在关联。
summaries.focus_relation: 与我们的磁性材料、相变、磁光性质和应变工程方向有一定关系，但论文主要是实验光谱与薄膜表征，未直接涉及第一性原理、机器学习或自旋模型。其应力调控相变和磁光响应的思路可作为计算研究的材料案例。
summaries.focus_suggestion: 可进一步用第一性原理计算比较 Ni-Mn-Ga 奥氏体和马氏体相的电子结构、磁各向异性及光学响应。还可构建有效哈密顿量或机器学习势，研究应力、孪晶和磁结构之间的耦合。
summaries.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
summaries.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
summaries.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Stress-induced Martensitic transformation in epitaxial Ni-Mn-Ga thin films and its correlation to optical and magneto-optical properties》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

summaries.title_en: Significant modulation of acoustoelectric current associated with charge density wave transitions
summaries.title_zh: 与电荷密度波相变相关的声电流显著调制
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2608.27959v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We studied acoustoelectric (AE) currents in materials that undergo charge density wave (CDW) transitions, induced by a surface acoustic wave (SAW) on a piezoelectric substrate. The polarity and magnitude of the AE current in NbSe₃ and 2H-TaSe₂ were modulated due to their CDW transitions. We also found that the sign of the AE current depends on the SAW propagation direction with respect to the crystalline axis of the substrate.A phenomenological model assuming strain-modified conductivity can qualitatively account for the significant modulation of the AE current associated with the CDW transition, as well as the SAW propagation orientation dependence. The present results offer a powerful probe for exploring SAW-electron interactions in van der Waals materials, thereby highlighting their potential for advancing the emerging field of straintronics.
summaries.abstract_zh: 研究考察了压电衬底表面声波诱导的、经历电荷密度波（CDW）相变材料中的声电流。NbSe3和2H-TaSe2中的声电流极性与幅值均会随CDW相变而调制，且其符号取决于表面声波相对于衬底晶轴的传播方向。基于应变调制电导率的唯象模型可定性解释这些现象，显示该方法可用于研究范德华材料中的表面声波-电子相互作用及应变电子学。
summaries.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了在压电衬底上由表面声波（SAW）诱导的、发生电荷密度波（CDW）相变材料中的声电流（AE电流）。NbSe3和2H-TaSe2中的AE电流极性和大小均因其CDW相变而受到调制。我们还发现，AE电流的符号取决于SAW相对于衬底晶轴的传播方向。假定电导率受应变修饰的唯象模型，可以定性解释与CDW相变相关的AE电流显著调制，以及对SAW传播取向的依赖性。目前结果为探索范德华材料中的SAW-电子相互作用提供了有力探针，并凸显了其推动新兴应变电子学领域发展的潜力。
summaries.summary: 研究考察了压电衬底表面声波诱导的、经历电荷密度波（CDW）相变材料中的声电流。NbSe3和2H-TaSe2中的声电流极性与幅值均会随CDW相变而调制，且其符号取决于表面声波相对于衬底晶轴的传播方向。基于应变调制电导率的唯象模型可定性解释这些现象，显示该方法可用于研究范德华材料中的表面声波-电子相互作用及应变电子学。

summaries.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
summaries.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程、晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
summaries.implication: 对《与电荷密度波相变相关的声电流显著调制》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

summaries.title_en: uMOF: A Universal Database, Benchmark, and Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials for Metal-Organic Frameworks
summaries.title_zh: uMOF：面向金属有机框架的通用数据库、基准与机器学习原子间势
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2608.28100v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundation machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) deliver near-ab-initio accuracy at a fraction of the computational cost, yet their promise for Metal-organic Frameworks (MOFs) remains largely unrealized as large unit cells make first-principles training data expensive to generate, fine-tuned models are scarce, and experimentally grounded benchmarks are scarcer still. We introduce uMOF, a three-part contribution addressing this gap. First, we release the largest and most accurate density functional theory dataset for MOFs to date, computed at the r²SCAN-D4 level of theory across 85524 configurations spanning 19950 unique frameworks and 79 elements, covering empty and gas-loaded structures, geometry optimizations, equations of state, and finite-temperature molecular dynamics. Second, we release a literature-mined benchmark of 3986 verified property values (3146 experimental) extracted from 626 papers by a seven-stage, checkpointed multi-pass large language model pipeline, linked to more than 650 crystallographic information files. Third, we release two universal MLIPs for MOFs, uMOF-MH and uMOF-POLAR, fine-tuned from two architecturally distinct MACE foundation models on the uMOF dataset. On near-equilibrium, ``Tier-1'' properties (bulk modulus, phonon-derived heat capacity) the uMOF models perform comparably to existing foundation and fine-tuned baselines. On harder, dynamics-sensitive properties like gas adsorption enthalpies via Widom insertion and adsorption isotherms, the uMOF models outperform every baseline we test, including MOF-specialized gas-capture models trained on datasets up to three orders of magnitude larger, cutting error by more than 80% to within experimental uncertainty. We trace this advantage to the physical diversity of the training data and to level of theory where a small (1.7%) fraction of MD simulations is decisive for MLIP stability.
summaries.abstract_zh: 本文提出uMOF，包括迄今规模最大且精度最高的MOF密度泛函理论数据集、从文献中挖掘的经核验性质基准，以及两种通用MOF机器学习原子间势。该数据集涵盖85524个构型、19950种框架和79种元素，基准包含从626篇论文提取的3986个性质值。uMOF模型在近平衡性质上与现有模型相当，而在气体吸附焓和吸附等温线等动力学敏感性质上优于所有测试基线，将误差降低80%以上至实验不确定度范围内。
summaries.abstract_zh_full: 基础机器学习原子间势（MLIP）能够以远低于计算成本的代价实现接近第一性原理的精度，但其在金属有机框架（MOF）中的前景在很大程度上尚未实现，因为大晶胞使第一性原理训练数据的生成成本高昂，微调模型稀少，而以实验为依据的基准更为稀缺。我们提出uMOF，这是一项由三部分组成的工作，旨在填补这一空白。首先，我们发布了迄今规模最大、精度最高的MOF密度泛函理论数据集：该数据集在r2SCAN-D4理论水平下计算，涵盖85524个构型、19950种不同框架和79种元素，包括空载与气体负载结构、几何优化、状态方程和有限温度分子动力学。第二，我们发布了一个通过文献挖掘建立的基准，其中包含由七阶段、带检查点的多轮大语言模型流程从626篇论文中提取的3986个经核验性质值，其中3146个为实验值，并与650多个晶体学信息文件相连接。第三，我们发布了两种面向MOF的通用MLIP，即uMOF-MH和uMOF-POLAR；它们是在uMOF数据集上，从两个架构不同的MACE基础模型微调而来。对于近平衡的“第一层级”性质，如体积模量和由声子导出的热容，uMOF模型的表现与现有基础模型和微调基线相当。对于更困难、对动力学敏感的性质，例如通过Widom插入计算的气体吸附焓和吸附等温线，uMOF模型优于我们测试的每一种基线，包括在规模大至三个数量级的数据集上训练的MOF专用气体捕集模型，将误差降低80%以上，达到实验不确定度范围内。我们将这一优势归因于训练数据的物理多样性和所采用的理论水平，其中仅占1.7%的分子动力学模拟对MLIP稳定性具有决定性作用。
summaries.summary: 本文提出uMOF，包括迄今规模最大且精度最高的MOF密度泛函理论数据集、从文献中挖掘的经核验性质基准，以及两种通用MOF机器学习原子间势。该数据集涵盖85524个构型、19950种框架和79种元素，基准包含从626篇论文提取的3986个性质值。uMOF模型在近平衡性质上与现有模型相当，而在气体吸附焓和吸附等温线等动力学敏感性质上优于所有测试基线，将误差降低80%以上至实验不确定度范围内。
authors: Théo Jaffrelot Inizan (Materials Sciences Division, Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, Berkeley, CA, USA, Bakar Institute of Digital Materials for the Planet, Division of Computing, Data Science, and Society, University of California, Berkeley, CA, USA), Prathami Divakar Kamath (Materials Sciences Division, Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, Berkeley, CA, USA, Department of Materials Science & Engineering, University of California, Berkeley, CA, USA), Alin Marin Elena (Scientific Computing Department, Science and Technology Facilities Council, Daresbury Laboratory, UK), Kristin A. Persson (Materials Sciences Division, Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, Berkeley, CA, USA, Department of Materials Science & Engineering, University of California, Berkeley, CA, USA)
summaries.focus_summary: 论文发布了面向金属有机框架的通用数据库、实验性质基准和机器学习原子间势。其数据集覆盖大量框架结构、气体负载构型、方程状态和有限温度分子动力学，并据此微调适用于 MOF 的机器学习势。
summaries.focus_relation: 与我们的机器学习势、材料数据库、主动学习和大规模分子动力学方法相关，但研究对象主要是金属有机框架，不属于团队当前重点材料体系。其数据集构建、实验基准关联和通用势微调策略可迁移到电池材料、钙钛矿或缺陷半导体研究。
summaries.focus_suggestion: 可借鉴其数据集和基准测试流程，为 HfO2 铁电体、卤化物钙钛矿、固态电解质和二维材料建立面向有限温度与缺陷的机器学习势。重点应评估势函数对相变、离子迁移、长程库仑作用和极化性质的描述能力。
summaries.method_point: uMOF建立含85,524个DFT构型、19,950种框架和79种元素的MOF数据集，并从626篇论文抽取并核验3,986个实验或文献性质形成外部基准。作者训练两种通用机器学习原子间势，评价不局限于近平衡结构与能量，还覆盖气体吸附焓和吸附等温线等对柔性骨架、客体相互作用和有限温采样敏感的量；摘要称这些指标相对测试基线的误差下降超过80%。所给信息没有给出两种势的网络类型、色散处理、吸附系综或DFT泛函，不能将其等同于特定MACE或NEP实现。
summaries.related_work: 该路线呼应MatBench、Open Catalyst及通用材料势的大规模预训练思路，但MOF的难点是孔道化学、金属节点配位、柔性框架与客体吸附同时存在，单纯优化晶体结构误差并不足以保证吸附预测。它与团队中从事多孔材料数据库、吸附热力学、图神经网络和第一性原理筛选的研究线相关，也可为铁电多孔框架或磁性MOF的结构-磁序联合建模提供数据组织范式。相较无机铁电体如BaTiO3，MOF更强调弱相互作用、构象多样性和化学元素覆盖。
summaries.implication: 团队可从已有磁性MOF、极性MOF及客体吸附数据中抽取结构、能量、力、应力、磁矩和电荷，按框架家族而非随机构型划分训练、验证和测试集以避免结构泄漏。对目标材料在298 K及目标压力下开展GCMC或MD，使用MLIP产生构型并以少量DFT单点校正吸附焓；若涉及铁电性，再沿极化翻转路径补充受限畸变构型。验证应同时报告晶格、声子稳定性、吸附等温线、吸附热，并对未见金属节点和未见客体做外推测试。

summaries.title_en: Mode-Specific Dynamics of CO2 Hydrogenation on Copper: The Hidden Role of Molecular Rotation
summaries.title_zh: 文献研究：Mode-Specific Dynamics of CO2 Hydrogenation on Copper: The Hidden Role of Molecular Rotation
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2608.27850v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Catalytic hydrogenation of CO2 to formate on copper is a key elementary step for CO2 utilization. Previous experimental and theoretical studies suggested an Eley-Rideal mechanism for this reaction, promoted by bending vibrational excitation, yet direct state resolved evidence remains lacking. Here, we present accurate dynamical predictions for CO2 hydrogenation on Cu(111) based on a full-dimensional first-principles neural network potential energy surface. Our calculations near-quantitatively reproduce the measured reaction probabilities, including their nozzle-temperature and incidence-energy dependence. Our state-resolved results indicate that while vibrational excitation of the bending mode enhances reactivity, it alone cannot account for the observed reactivity increase with nozzle temperature. Instead, rotational excitation plays a dominant role, mainly attributable to the significant change in anisotropy of the molecular polar orientation as CO2 accesses the transition state. This mode-specific mechanistic insight revises the conventional interpretation and lays the foundation for the precise control of CO2 hydrogenation on catalysts.

summaries.title_en: Observation of subharmonic charge-density-wave correlations in La-based cuprates
summaries.title_zh: La基铜酸盐中次谐波电荷密度波关联的观测
summaries.abstract: Author(s): J.-S. Lee, S. A. Kivelson, H. Lee, T. Wang, Y. Ikeda, T. Taniguchi, C.-T. Kuo, M. Fujita, and C.-C. Kao Suggestive but indirect evidence for pair-density-wave correlations has been reported in several high- T c cuprates, yet a bulk-sensitive scattering signature of the expected subharmonic charge response has remained elusive. Here, the authors use resonant soft x-ray scattering to identify a reproducible subharmonic charge density wave response near half the primary charge-ordering wave vector in two La-based cuprates. The response emerges in the stripe-ordered, layer-decoupled superconducting regime, where charge, spin, and superconducting correlations are intertwined. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 074514] Published Mon Aug 31, 2026
summaries.abstract_zh: 此前在若干高温超导铜酸盐中已有关于对密度波关联的提示性但间接的证据，但预期次谐波电荷响应的体敏感散射信号一直难以观测。作者利用共振软X射线散射，在两种La基铜酸盐中识别出位于主要电荷有序波矢约一半处、且可重复观测的次谐波电荷密度波响应。该响应出现在条纹有序、层间解耦的超导区域，其中电荷、自旋与超导关联彼此交织。
summaries.abstract_zh_full: 已有研究在若干高温超导铜酸盐中报告了关于对密度波关联的提示性但间接的证据，然而，预期中的次谐波电荷响应的体敏感散射特征仍然难以捉摸。在这里，作者利用共振软X射线散射，在两种La基铜酸盐中识别出一种可重复的次谐波电荷密度波响应，其位置接近主要电荷有序波矢的一半。该响应出现在条纹有序且层间解耦的超导区域，在这一范围内，电荷、自旋和超导关联相互交织。[《Physical Review B》114，074514]发表于2026年8月31日，星期一。
summaries.summary: 此前在若干高温超导铜酸盐中已有关于对密度波关联的提示性但间接的证据，但预期次谐波电荷响应的体敏感散射信号一直难以观测。作者利用共振软X射线散射，在两种La基铜酸盐中识别出位于主要电荷有序波矢约一半处、且可重复观测的次谐波电荷密度波响应。该响应出现在条纹有序、层间解耦的超导区域，其中电荷、自旋与超导关联彼此交织。
authors: J.-S. Lee, S. A. Kivelson, H. Lee, T. Wang, Y. Ikeda, T. Taniguchi, C.-T. Kuo, M. Fujita, and C.-C. Kao
summaries.focus_summary: 该论文通过共振软X射线散射观测 La 基铜酸盐中约为主电荷序波矢一半的次谐波电荷密度波关联。该信号出现在条纹序、层间解耦的超导区域，显示电荷、自旋和超导关联之间存在耦合。
summaries.focus_relation: 与我们的电荷密度波、强关联材料、超导、磁性结构和相变方向相关，但研究主要是实验观测，且未直接涉及材料模拟或机器学习方法。其电荷序与自旋、超导序共存的现象可为有效哈密顿量和蒙特卡洛研究提供物理问题。
summaries.focus_suggestion: 可进一步阅读其关于次谐波电荷序与配对密度波关系的理论解释。若开展跟进，可构建包含电荷序、自旋序和超导序的有效模型，研究层间耦合及竞争序的相图。
summaries.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
summaries.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

summaries.title_en: Quantum geometric bounds at finite temperature for one-dimensional chiral systems
summaries.title_zh: 一维手征系统有限温度下的量子几何界
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2608.27944v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The geometry and topology of quantum states are intimately related at zero temperature through exact bounds that constrain geometric quantities from below by topological invariants. At finite-temperature, however, the analogous relations remain unclear. Here we establish rigorous geometric lower bounds for one-dimensional (1D) chiral-symmetric systems at finite temperature within the Uhlmann's framework for mixed states. We show that the Bures length is bounded by a continuous geometric phase angle. We further derive a temperature-dependent bound that interpolates between the zero-temperature limit and a trivial high-temperature regime. Our results are verified analytically and numerically using the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) model and the spinless Kitaev chain model. Finally, we discuss potential ways to detect the geometry of the density matrix in quantum circuits, with the quantum imaginary time evolution (QITE) method.
summaries.abstract_zh: 本文在混态的Uhlmann框架下，建立了一维手征对称系统有限温度下的严格几何下界。研究证明Bures长度受连续几何相位角约束，并导出一个连接零温极限与平凡高温区域的温度依赖界。SSH模型和无自旋Kitaev链的解析与数值结果验证了该理论，并讨论了通过量子虚时间演化测量密度矩阵几何的方法。
summaries.abstract_zh_full: 在零温下，量子态的几何与拓扑通过精确界限密切相关，这些界限利用拓扑不变量从下方约束几何量。然而，在有限温度下，相应关系仍不清楚。本文在混态的Uhlmann框架内，为一维（1D）手征对称系统建立了严格的有限温度几何下界。我们表明，Bures长度受一个连续几何相位角的下界约束。我们进一步导出了一个温度依赖的界，该界在零温极限与平凡的高温区域之间插值。我们利用Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模型和无自旋Kitaev链模型，从解析和数值两方面验证了结果。最后，我们讨论了利用量子虚时间演化（QITE）方法在量子电路中探测密度矩阵几何的潜在途径。

summaries.title_en: Universal Hamiltonian simulators in one and two dimensions
summaries.title_zh: 一维和二维中的通用哈密顿量模拟器
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2102.02991v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: A major quantum computing application is analog Hamiltonian simulations, in which the low-lying spectrum of a simulator Hamiltonian H' encodes the physics of a target Hamiltonian H. Some families of 2D spin-lattice Hamiltonians---such as the Heisenberg or XY model on the square lattice---are known to be ``universal'' simulators, in the sense that they can simulate any target Hamiltonian. Unfortunately, while the known simulations of 1D or 2D target Hamiltonians are efficient, they require resources growing exponentially with system sizes for target Hamiltonians with general connectivity. This leaves many important cases such as 3D or all-to-all-connected target Hamiltonians out of reach in practice. Here we remedy this situation and show how the known 2D universal families of Hamiltonians and a new 1D family can simulate all target local Hamiltonians, with only polynomial-scaling overhead. This exponential improvement is achieved by a nonperturbative method combining the quantum phase-estimation algorithm and the circuit-to-Hamiltonian construction. Furthermore, all Hamiltonians efficiently simulable by quantum circuits, including nonlocal ones, also have efficient analog simulators in our 2D and 1D universal families. Our work establishes that analog simulations of general Hamiltonians can be made efficient, significantly expanding the application potential of analog Hamiltonian simulations in near-term quantum technologies.
summaries.abstract_zh: 模拟器哈密顿量的低能谱可编码目标哈密顿量的物理性质，但既有一维或二维方案在处理一般连接结构时需要指数增长的资源。本文表明，已知的二维通用哈密顿量族及一个新的一维哈密顿量族可用多项式开销模拟所有局域目标哈密顿量。该方法结合量子相位估计算法与电路到哈密顿量构造，并将高效模拟的范围扩展到可由量子电路高效模拟的非局域哈密顿量。
summaries.abstract_zh_full: 量子计算的一项重要应用是模拟哈密顿量，其中模拟器哈密顿量 H' 的低能谱编码了目标哈密顿量 H 的物理性质。某些二维自旋晶格哈密顿量族，例如方格晶格上的海森堡模型或 XY 模型，已知是“通用”模拟器，即它们能够模拟任意目标哈密顿量。遗憾的是，尽管已知的一维或二维目标哈密顿量模拟是高效的，但对于具有一般连接结构的目标哈密顿量，它们所需资源会随系统尺寸呈指数增长。这使得许多重要情形，例如三维或全连接目标哈密顿量，在实践中难以处理。这里我们解决了这一问题，并说明已知的二维通用哈密顿量族以及一个新的一维哈密顿量族如何仅以多项式标度的开销模拟所有目标局域哈密顿量。这种指数级改进通过一种结合量子相位估计算法和电路到哈密顿量构造的非微扰方法实现。此外，所有能够由量子电路高效模拟的哈密顿量，包括非局域哈密顿量，也都能在我们的二维和一维通用哈密顿量族中得到高效的模拟器。我们的工作确立了对一般哈密顿量的模拟可以实现高效，从而显著拓展了模拟哈密顿量在近期量子技术中的应用潜力。

summaries.title_en: A Schwinger-Keldysh Formulation of Semiclassical Operator Dynamics
summaries.title_zh: 半经典算符动力学的 Schwinger-Keldysh 表述
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2602.02106v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this work we develop a real-time Schwinger-Keldysh formulation of Krylov dynamics that treats Krylov complexity as an in-in observable generated by a closed time contour path integral. The resulting generating functional exposes an emergent phase-space description in which the Lanczos coefficients define an effective Hamiltonian governing operator motion along the Krylov chain. In the semiclassical limit, exponential complexity growth arises from hyperbolic trajectories, and asymptotically linear Lanczos growth appears as a universal chaotic fixed point, with sub-leading deformations classified as irrelevant, marginal or relevant. Going beyond the saddle, the Schwinger-Keldysh framework provides controlled access to fluctuations and large deviations of Krylov complexity, revealing sharp signatures of integrability-chaos crossovers that are invisible at the level of the mean. This formulation reorganises Krylov complexity into a dynamical field-theoretic framework and identifies new fluctuation diagnostics of operator growth in closed quantum systems.
summaries.abstract_zh: 本文发展了 Krylov 动力学的实时 Schwinger-Keldysh 表述，将 Krylov 复杂度作为由闭合时间轮廓路径积分生成的 in-in 观测量处理。该框架中，Lanczos 系数定义控制 Krylov 链上算符运动的有效哈密顿量；在半经典极限下，双曲轨道导致复杂度指数增长，渐近线性 Lanczos 增长对应普适混沌不动点。该形式还可受控地研究复杂度涨落和大偏差，并揭示平均值分析无法观测的可积性至混沌交叉特征。
summaries.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们发展了 Krylov 动力学的一种实时 Schwinger-Keldysh 表述，该表述将 Krylov 复杂度作为由闭合时间轮廓路径积分生成的 in-in 观测量来处理。所得生成泛函揭示了一种涌现的相空间描述，其中 Lanczos 系数定义了一个有效哈密顿量，支配算符沿 Krylov 链的运动。在半经典极限下，复杂度的指数增长源于双曲轨道，而渐近线性的 Lanczos 增长则表现为一个普适的混沌不动点，其次级形变可分为无关、边缘或相关形变。超越鞍点近似后，Schwinger-Keldysh 框架提供了对 Krylov 复杂度涨落和大偏差的受控研究途径，揭示出在平均值层面不可见的、可积性到混沌交叉的鲜明特征。该表述将 Krylov 复杂度重组为一个动力学场论框架，并识别出闭合量子系统中算符增长的新型涨落诊断量。
summaries.summary: 本文发展了 Krylov 动力学的实时 Schwinger-Keldysh 表述，将 Krylov 复杂度作为由闭合时间轮廓路径积分生成的 in-in 观测量处理。该框架中，Lanczos 系数定义控制 Krylov 链上算符运动的有效哈密顿量；在半经典极限下，双曲轨道导致复杂度指数增长，渐近线性 Lanczos 增长对应普适混沌不动点。该形式还可受控地研究复杂度涨落和大偏差，并揭示平均值分析无法观测的可积性至混沌交叉特征。
authors: Jeff Murugan, Hendrik J. R. van Zyl
summaries.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
summaries.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
summaries.implication: 对《半经典算符动力学的 Schwinger-Keldysh 表述》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

summaries.title_en: Vectorized Symmetric and Fermionic Tensor Network Implementations for GPU-Accelerated Variational Monte Carlo
summaries.title_zh: 文献研究：Vectorized Symmetric and Fermionic Tensor Network Implementations for GPU-Accelerated Variational Monte Carlo
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2608.27861v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Variational Monte Carlo (VMC) calculations based on tensor networks (TN) have recently achieved competitive accuracy in ground-state calculations of strongly correlated spin and fermionic systems. However, existing tensor network VMC (TN-VMC) algorithms have not been formulated in a manner that can fully utilize GPU acceleration. We tackle the key missing ingredient, namely, the vectorized evaluation of tensor network amplitudes and tensor network operations. This ensures high GPU utilization by batching over computations with identical structure. In particular, we show how to achieve vectorization for the practically relevant case of abelian symmetric tensor networks (which includes fermionic tensor networks) by developing a ``flat'' tensor network formalism for block-sparse tensor representation and contraction. Using this, we construct a GPU-adapted symmetric TN-VMC workflow with batched tensor network computation. In the two-dimensional Fermi--Hubbard model, we demonstrate a GPU speedup of up to 300 × over single core CPU implementations, for fermionic TN variational wavefunctions.

authors: Si-Jing Du, Johnnie Gray, Ao Chen, Garnet Kin-Lic Chan
summaries.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：蒙特卡洛统计采样，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
summaries.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
summaries.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Vectorized Symmetric and Fermionic Tensor Network Implementations for GPU-Accelerated Variational Monte Carlo》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

summaries.title_en: Strong electron correlations and ligand hybridization for altermagnetism
summaries.title_zh: 文献研究：Strong electron correlations and ligand hybridization for altermagnetism
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2605.14248v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Spin-band splitting is a hallmark of altermagnetism, intrinsically linked to magnetic ordering driven by electron correlations. However, recent inconsistencies in the detection of altermagnetism in strongly correlated altermagnet candidates have cast doubt on the robustness of this phenomenon and its dependence on many-body effects. Here, density functional theory combined with dynamical mean-field theory (DFT+DMFT), we dissect the electronic origins of altermagnetism in three prototypical candidates: MnF₂, MnTe, and RuO₂. In MnF₂, we identify pronounced local electron correlations within Mn-3d states and uncover a distinct Mott gap in the visible range. The strong correlations markedly localize the Mn-3d electrons, leading to a narrowing of the spin-resolved bandwidth and, consequently, a suppression of spin-band splitting. By contrast, MnTe provides an ideal platform for altermagnetism, exhibiting substantial local Mn-3d magnetic moments due to the strong correlations and pronounced spin-band splitting, enabled by robust Mn-3d--Te-5p orbital hybridization. RuO₂ manifests as a Pauli paramagnet with vanishing local moments, even in its antiferromagnetic phase. Nonetheless, it exhibits significant spin-band splitting, indicative of itinerant altermagnetic behavior. Our results reveal that both strong local electron correlations and judicious ligand selection to promote orbital hybridization are key prerequisites to realizing altermagnetism in strongly correlated systems. These insights pave the way for the rational design and discovery of novel altermagnetic materials.

summaries.focus_summary: 论文结合密度泛函理论和动力学平均场理论，分析 MnF2、MnTe 和 RuO2 中电子关联与配体杂化对交替磁性的影响。研究指出，强关联会导致 MnF2 中电子局域化并抑制自旋能带劈裂，而 MnTe 中强的 Mn-3d 与 Te-5p 杂化能够同时维持局域磁矩和显著的自旋能带劈裂。
summaries.focus_relation: 与我们的交替磁性、强关联磁性、电子结构、非共线磁性和自旋轨道耦合方向直接相关。该工作强调电子关联和轨道杂化对交替磁性判定的重要性，可补充常规第一性原理计算，并为构建有效自旋或电子哈密顿量提供物理依据。
summaries.focus_suggestion: 建议对候选交替磁体开展 DFT+DMFT 或其他超越常规 DFT 的关联电子计算，系统比较磁矩、能带劈裂、轨道杂化和温度效应。还可提取交换相互作用、磁各向异性和自旋输运参数，评估其自旋电子学应用潜力。

summaries.title_en: First-Principles DFT Study of Ferroelectric-to-Antiferroelectric Phase Transitions in LiTaO₃ under Electric Boundary Conditions
summaries.title_zh: 文献研究：First-Principles DFT Study of Ferroelectric-to-Antiferroelectric Phase Transitions in LiTaO₃ under Electric Boundary Conditions
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2608.27645v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric and antiferroelectric phases of LiTaO₃ compete under different electric boundary conditions. First-principles density-functional calculations show that the high-symmetry reference structure supports two relevant unstable Γ modes: a polar A₂ᵤ mode at 181i cm⁻¹ that condenses into the ferroelectric (FE) phase, and an antipolar A₂g mode at 103i cm⁻¹ that condenses into the antiferroelectric (AFE) phase. Under short-circuit conditions the FE phase is the global minimum, with a well depth of approx 144 meV. Under open-circuit conditions the FE phase is destabilized by the unscreened depolarization field and the AFE phase becomes the ground state, with a well depth of approx 19 meV. A weakly unstable longitudinal-optic mode at 48.3i cm⁻¹ yields a well of only approx 0.24 meV and is thermodynamically irrelevant. Mapping the free energy versus electric displacement D locates a second-order FEłeftrightarrowAFE transition at D_c=0.051 C/m², lower than the corresponding 0.07 C/m² in LiNbO₃ and therefore more accessible experimentally.

summaries.title_en: Switchable chiral antiferromagnetism through nonlinear magnetic susceptibility
summaries.title_zh: 文献研究：Switchable chiral antiferromagnetism through nonlinear magnetic susceptibility
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2608.28546v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Antiferromagnets (AFM) have attracted considerable attention in recent years because a number of nontrivial, technologically relevant properties associated with time-reversal symmetry (TRS) breaking are discovered in many materials. However, time-reversal (TR) partners of AFM states are generally challenging to be selected deterministically except in a few cases with nonzero net magnetization. Recently, it has been shown that the TR partners of the kagome spin ice ground state in HoAgGe with strictly zero net magnetization can be selected through a nonlinear magnetic susceptibility ḩi⁽¹⁾. In this work, we generalize this scenario to a broad class of chiral AFM with zero net magnetization but field-switchable ground states through ḩi⁽¹⁾. After a general discussion of ḩi⁽¹⁾ and its symmetry constraints, we first present a first-principles formalism for calculating it including both mean-field and self-consistent corrections, and then apply the approach to the noncollinear AFM family Mn₃XN (X= Ni, Ag, Ga, Zn, Sn) in the Γ₅g phase. An intuitive picture of the origin of ḩi⁽¹⁾ in similar noncollinear AFM is illustrated using 3-sublattice toy model. The model also predicts a nontrivial temperature dependence of ḩi⁽¹⁾ due to competitions between the longitudinal and transverse single-spin susceptibilities. Our work shows that nonlinear susceptibility can serve as a general protocol for accessing and switching TR partners in fully compensated AFM.

summaries.title_en: Simplified criteria for identifying and designing altermagnetic crystals in real space
summaries.title_zh: 文献研究：Simplified criteria for identifying and designing altermagnetic crystals in real space
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2605.27151v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnetism is a compensated magnetic phase characterized by zero net magnetization and exchange-driven spin splitting. However, identifying altermagnets among collinear antiferromagnets usually requires full magnetic-space-group or spin-group analysis, which is not always intuitive. Here we formulate a simple real-space criterion based on how the crystallographic operations of the host nonmagnetic structure permute the two opposite-spin sublattices. We show that altermagnets usually exist on collinear compensated antiferromagnets whose magnetic primitive cell coincides with the host nonmagnetic crystallographic primitive cell. In this case, altermagnetic spin splitting is generally allowed unless an inversion-type operation exists that exchanges the two opposite-spin sublattices. Using chemically ordered Mn2SSe prototypes derived from zinc-blende or rocksalt parent structures, we demonstrate that these criteria can be easily used to construct the three symmetry classes by controlling chemical ordering and magnetic-sublattice permutation. Similar rules can also be applied to low-dimensional crystals or quasicrystals. Our work reduces the identification of altermagnets to a transparent real-space symmetry test and provides a practical route for designing altermagnetic crystals.

summaries.focus_summary: 该工作提出基于实空间中晶体对称操作如何置换相反自旋子晶格的简化判据，用于识别和设计交替磁体。作者指出，当补偿共线反铁磁体的磁原胞与非磁母体晶体原胞一致时，除非存在交换两类自旋子晶格的反演型操作，否则通常允许交替磁性自旋劈裂。
summaries.focus_relation: 交替磁性是团队明确关注的量子功能磁性方向，该工作与对称性分析、磁性电子结构和高通量筛选直接相关。其简化实空间规则可用于缩小候选材料搜索空间，并辅助解释自旋劈裂的结构来源。

summaries.title_zh: 文献研究：Candidate for a Fractional Topological Insulator in Twisted MoTe2
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2601.18508v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The interplay among electronic correlation, topology, and time-reversal-symmetry (TRS) often leads to exotic quantum states of matter, as highlighted by the discoveries of fractional Chern insulators (FCIs) in twisted bilayer MoTe2 (tMoTe2). Among the FCIs in tMoTe2, the most robust is at a hole filling factor of v=-2/3 per moiré unit cell. Here, employing pump-probe circular dichroism (CD) measurement on tMoTe2 at twist angles (3.9 and 3.7 degrees), we show that a correlated state at v =-4/3 exhibits an unusual Ising antiferromagnet behavior. The v =-4/3 state with no net magnetization undergoes first order phase transitions at extremely low magnetic fields of ~ 2-6 mT to partially valley polarized (PVP) states. This behavior is notably absent for all other correlated states in tMoTe2 and also disappears for v =-4/3 at higher or lower twist angles (4.0 or 3.3 degree). The observed magnetic signature is consistent with a theoretically proposed fractional topological insulator (FTI), consisting of two copies of v =-2/3 FCIs with opposite chirality in the two K valleys. The experimental results are supported by interacting continuum model calculations that reveal the extreme closeness in energy ( < 1 meV) between the putative FTI and PVP states. Our findings present a candidate FTI with TRS and call for advanced transport and imaging measurements to establish the quantized helical edge modes.

summaries.title_en: Quantum Geometric Origin of Nonlinear Current Induced Orbital Magnetization
summaries.title_zh: 非线性电流诱导轨道磁化的量子几何起源
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2608.28231v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electric generation of magnetization is a focus of condensed matter research, and has recently been advanced into the nonlinear regime. However, due to the nonlocal nature of orbital magnetism, how to properly formulate nonlinear current-induced orbital magnetization remains a fundamental challenge. Here, we develop the proper theory for this effect. This is based on the microscopic derivation of field-corrected orbital magnetic moment of a Bloch electron, a critical missing piece in the present theory. We show that the quantum geometric origin of this phenomenon lies in both the anomalous orbital polarizability and the Berry-connection polarizability, which often provide competing contributions. Combining our theory with first-principles calculations, we predict significant, experimentally accessible nonlinear orbital magnetization generated in strained bilayer graphene, monolayer 1T' MoS₂ and MoTe₂. Remarkably, nonlinear orbital magnetization can dominate over its spin counterpart in materials with topological band features, irrespective of the spin-orbit coupling strength.
summaries.abstract_zh: 本文建立了非线性电流诱导轨道磁化的理论，核心是对布洛赫电子场修正轨道磁矩的微观推导。研究表明，该现象源于反常轨道极化率和 Berry 联络极化率，两者通常会产生相互竞争的贡献。结合第一性原理计算，作者预测了应变双层石墨烯、单层 1T′-MoS₂ 和 MoTe₂ 中显著且可实验观测的非线性轨道磁化。
summaries.abstract_zh_full: 电场产生磁化是凝聚态物理研究的一个重点，并且近年来已经拓展到非线性领域。然而，由于轨道磁性的非局域性，如何恰当地表述非线性电流诱导轨道磁化仍然是一个基本挑战。在此，我们建立了该效应的适当理论。该理论建立在对布洛赫电子场修正轨道磁矩的微观推导之上，而这一内容是现有理论中关键的缺失环节。我们表明，这一现象的量子几何起源同时存在于反常轨道极化率和 Berry 联络极化率之中，二者通常会提供相互竞争的贡献。我们将该理论与第一性原理计算相结合，预测了在应变双层石墨烯、单层 1T′ MoS₂ 和 MoTe₂ 中能够产生显著且实验上可实现的非线性轨道磁化。值得注意的是，在具有拓扑能带特征的材料中，无论自旋-轨道耦合强度如何，非线性轨道磁化都可能超过其自旋对应项。

authors: Xue-Jin Zhang, Yue-Xin Huang, Wei Du, Xiaolong Feng, Shen Lai, Cong Xiao, Qian Niu, Shengyuan A. Yang
summaries.focus_summary: 该工作建立非线性电流诱导轨道磁化的理论，给出场修正轨道磁矩的微观推导，并指出反常轨道极化率和贝里联络极化率是其量子几何来源。结合第一性原理计算，作者预测应变双层石墨烯、单层1T' MoS₂和MoTe₂中可观测的非线性轨道磁化，且在拓扑能带材料中可超过自旋贡献。

summaries.focus_suggestion: 建议重点研读场修正轨道磁矩和响应函数的规范不变处理，并通过Wannier插值复现候选体系的贝里相关量。可进一步研究铁电滑移、磁序或层间扭转如何调控该非线性轨道磁化，并评估缺陷和有限温度散射的影响。

summaries.title_en: Fractionalization, emergent SU(N) symmetries, and fragmentation in layered quantum spin-orbital models
summaries.title_zh: 文献研究：Fractionalization, emergent SU(N) symmetries, and fragmentation in layered quantum spin-orbital models
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2605.22908v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose a family of layered quantum spin-orbital models as a platform to study fractionalization, unconventional forms of symmetry-breaking order, and their possible coexistence. The models are built by stacking N layers of a square-lattice system in which Kitaev-type interactions promote the formation of a Z₂ quantum spin-orbital liquid and coupling the different layers via Ising spin interactions. Using a parton construction, we show how, at low energies, these Hamiltonians can be mapped to N-component Fermi Hubbard models on a π-flux square lattice at half filling. We also demonstrate that the models acquire an emergent SU(N) symmetry in the limit of equal all-to-all interlayer couplings and argue that, for N>2, the proximity to this limit offers the potential to realize an array of competing phases. To illustrate this point, we compute the zero-temperature phase diagram of the effective N=3 Hubbard model within mean-field theory and uncover rich phenomena, including intertwined orders and flavor-selective localization. Mapping back to the original degrees of freedom reveals that the ground states realize distinct forms of magnetic fragmentation, wherein the orbitals remain in a quantum liquid state whereas the spins can present conventional long-range order or nonlocal order characterized by a nontrivial string order parameters. We highlight possible extensions of our construction as well as its potential to provide concrete microscopic models for different fractionalized quantum critical points.

summaries.focus_summary: 该论文提出一类分层量子自旋轨道模型，研究分数化、非常规对称性破缺及其共存，并通过部分子构造将模型映射到具有π通量的多组分费米 Hubbard 模型。研究发现，层间全连接耦合极限具有涌现 SU(N) 对称性，并通过平均场方法分析了多种竞争相和选择性局域化现象。

summaries.focus_suggestion: 可进一步使用量子蒙特卡洛、张量网络或自旋动力学方法检验平均场相图，并分析有限温度性质。也可寻找具有分层自旋轨道耦合和近似 Kitaev 相互作用的实际范德华材料作为材料实现候选。

summaries.title_en: The bixbyite framework as a platform for frustrated noncollinear magnetism: resolving the magnetic ground state of β-Fe₂O₃
summaries.title_zh: 文献研究：The bixbyite framework as a platform for frustrated noncollinear magnetism: resolving the magnetic ground state of β-Fe₂O₃
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2606.17842v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnetic behavior across Fe₂O₃ polymorphs varies widely despite identical chemistry, highlighting crystal architecture as a key determinant of exchange topology, magnetic anisotropy, and ultimately magnetic order. Here, using neutron and synchrotron X-ray diffraction, we establish the magnetic ground state of the poorly understood bixbyite β-Fe₂O₃ polymorph and uncover the structural origin of its strong frustration. Below the Néel temperature, a noncollinear antiferromagnetic state emerges through activation of the mH₁⁺ irrep at the H-point [k=(1,1,1)] and the antitranslation (1'|tfrac12,tfrac12,tfrac12), breaking the body centering and yielding two interpenetrating primitive cubic magnetic subcells with inverted moments and nonpolar type-IV symmetry. Under exclusively antiferromagnetic Fe³⁺-O-Fe³⁺ interactions, β-Fe₂O₃ exhibits a large frustration index (f approx 7.56). This behavior originates from the intrinsic geometry of the bixbyite lattice: two magnetic sublattices with distinct point symmetries and anisotropy constraints are embedded in a three-dimensional exchange network containing interconnected triangular and hexagonal motifs. In 111 planes, Fe2 ions form hexagonal rings interconnected by frustrated triangular units, while locally Ising-like Fe1 ions occupy the ring centers. Our results thus identify the bixbyite architecture as a promising general platform for frustrated noncollinear magnetism. Extending this structural framework to other magnetic transition-metal or 4f ions opens a materials space for engineering competing exchange interactions and anisotropies, potentially stabilizing new noncollinear and field-tunable magnetic states.

summaries.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《The bixbyite framework as a platform for frustrated noncollinear magnetism: resolving the magnetic ground state of β-Fe₂O₃》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

summaries.title_en: Collinear altermagnetism for 3D chiral higher-order topological insulators
summaries.title_zh: 文献研究：Collinear altermagnetism for 3D chiral higher-order topological insulators
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2608.27552v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Despite significant progress in the study of higher-order topological insulators (HOTIs), the chiral C₄T-protected HOTI has remained elusive in electronic materials, where C₄T denotes the product of a four-fold rotation and time-reversal symmetry. We show that altermagnetism, a recently discovered form of collinear magnetism, provides a new route to realize this elusive phase. Specifically, we construct a microscopic model that combines a three-dimensional topological insulator with a collinear d-wave altermagnet on a Lieb lattice. Through analytical and numerical calculations, we show that the magnetism shifts and gaps the surface Dirac cones to produce the desired chiral hinge channels. Finally, we identify promising material classes to realise our proposal. Our results establish collinear altermagnetism as a route to intrinsic chiral higher-order topology and open a new path toward the discovery of C₄T-protected HOTIs in real materials.

summaries.title_en: Two-dimensional quantum Griffith singularity in three-dimensional ZrNₓ superconducting films
summaries.title_zh: 三维 ZrNₓ 超导薄膜中的二维量子 Griffith 奇异性
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2608.28166v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the experimental observation of two-dimensional (2D) quantum Griffiths singularity (QGS) in sim200-nm-thick epitaxial ZrNₓ superconducting films. The films possess a rock-salt structure and are three-dimensional (3D) with respect to superconductivity. For each film with x gtrsim 1.30, the low-temperature magnetoresistance isotherms under fields perpendicular and parallel to the film plane cross over at a broad magnetic field range independently rather than at a single crossing point. Despite the macroscopic 3D nature of the superconductivity, the magnetoresistance isotherms at selected adjacent temperatures follow the theoretical prediction of power-law scaling for 2D superconducting systems, rather than that for 3D systems. The effective critical exponent zν, obtained by analyzing the magnetoresistance isotherms using the 2D power-law scaling, increases with decreasing temperature and diverges as the quantum phase transition is approached. In addition, the resistivity data near the superconductor-insulator or superconductor-metal transitions obey an activated scaling form that describes the quantum phase transition of 2D superconducting systems governed by an infinite-randomness critical point. The QGS in the ZrNₓ films is attributed to quenched disorder induced by intrinsic defects, such as Zr vacancies and N interstitials, which creates spatially inhomogeneous superconducting rare regions. The dynamics of these rare regions, which may exhibit effective 2D characteristics near the quantum critical point, dominate the transport properties of the system near the quantum phase transition. Our results provide compelling evidence for the existence of QGS in 3D superconductors and highlight the crucial role of disorder-induced inhomogeneity in determining the critical behavior of quantum phase transitions.
summaries.abstract_zh: 我们在约 200 nm 厚的外延 ZrNₓ 超导薄膜中实验观测到二维量子 Griffith 奇异性。尽管超导性在宏观上具有三维特征，磁阻等温线却遵循二维超导系统的幂律标度，并显示出趋近量子相变时发散的有效临界指数。研究将这一现象归因于本征缺陷引起的淬灭无序及其形成的空间非均匀超导稀有区域。
summaries.abstract_zh_full: 我们在约 200 nm 厚的外延 ZrNₓ 超导薄膜中报告了二维（2D）量子 Griffith 奇异性（QGS）的实验观测结果。这些薄膜具有岩盐结构，并且就超导性而言属于三维（3D）体系。对于每一片 x 大于或约等于 1.30 的薄膜，在低温下，垂直于薄膜平面和平行于薄膜平面的磁场所对应的磁阻等温线，会在一个较宽的磁场范围内分别发生交叉，而不是在单一交叉点处交叉。尽管超导性在宏观上具有三维性质，但选定的相邻温度下的磁阻等温线遵循二维超导系统幂律标度的理论预言，而不是三维系统的理论预言。通过使用二维幂律标度分析磁阻等温线得到的有效临界指数 zν 随温度降低而增大，并在接近量子相变时发散。此外，超导体-绝缘体或超导体-金属转变附近的电阻率数据遵循一种激活标度形式，该形式描述了由无穷随机性临界点支配的二维超导系统量子相变。ZrNₓ 薄膜中的 QGS 被归因于本征缺陷（例如 Zr 空位和 N 间隙原子）所诱导的淬灭无序，这些缺陷形成了空间上不均匀的超导稀有区域。这些稀有区域的动力学在量子临界点附近可能表现出有效的二维特征，并在量子相变附近主导体系的输运性质。我们的结果为三维超导体中存在 QGS 提供了有力证据，并突出了无序诱导的非均匀性在决定量子相变临界行为中的关键作用。
summaries.summary: 我们在约 200 nm 厚的外延 ZrNₓ 超导薄膜中实验观测到二维量子 Griffith 奇异性。尽管超导性在宏观上具有三维特征，磁阻等温线却遵循二维超导系统的幂律标度，并显示出趋近量子相变时发散的有效临界指数。研究将这一现象归因于本征缺陷引起的淬灭无序及其形成的空间非均匀超导稀有区域。
authors: Zi-Yan Han, Li-Min Yu, Yu-Cheng Cong, Yang Yang, Zhi-Xiang Sun, Zhi-Qing Li
summaries.focus_summary: 该工作在约200纳米厚外延ZrNₓ超导薄膜中实验观察到二维量子Griffiths奇异性。尽管薄膜的超导宏观行为呈三维特征，其磁阻标度和临界指数演化却符合二维量子相变图像。

summaries.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《三维 ZrNₓ 超导薄膜中的二维量子 Griffith 奇异性》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

summaries.title_en: Interplay of Quasiperiodicity, Hubbard Interactions, and Staggered Magnetism in a 1D Ring: Localization and Re-entrant Characteristics
summaries.title_zh: 文献研究：Interplay of Quasiperiodicity, Hubbard Interactions, and Staggered Magnetism in a 1D Ring: Localization and Re-entrant Characteristics
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2603.29177v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study interaction-induced localization in a spinful quasiperiodic Hubbard ring with quasiperiodically modulated hopping and a staggered spin-dependent Zeeman field using a self-consistent Hartree-Fock approach. We characterize localization through the inverse participation ratio, normalized participation ratio, and multifractal analysis, and further examine its signatures in self-consistent real-space observables, including double occupancy, density fluctuations, local entropy, spin-density-wave order, and related correlation measures. As the Hubbard interaction is increased, we find a nonmonotonic evolution of the eigenstates: an initially extended regime gives way to an intermediate localized phase, followed by reentrant delocalization at stronger interactions. The width of this intermediate regime grows systematically with both the quasiperiodic hopping amplitude and the staggered Zeeman-field strength, indicating a cooperative enhancement of localization by these two ingredients. In the localized regime, the self-consistent interaction produces pronounced spin dependence in both the spectra and localization properties, resulting in distinct responses of the spin-up and spin-down sectors. The interaction-driven crossover is consistently captured by the real-space observables and further corroborated by real-time wave-packet dynamics, which reveal successive ballistic, confined, and reentrant-transport regimes consistent with the underlying eigenstate character. These results provide a unified framework for understanding the interplay of quasiperiodicity, electronic interactions, and spin-dependent fields in controlling localization, criticality, and quantum transport in correlated quasiperiodic systems.

summaries.title_en: Bad Metal Behavior and Lifshitz Transition of a Nagaoka Ferromagnet
summaries.title_zh: 文献研究：Bad Metal Behavior and Lifshitz Transition of a Nagaoka Ferromagnet
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2510.01909v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Using an extension of the fermionic functional renormalization group for systems where strong correlations give rise to projected Hilbert spaces we calculate the phase diagram and the electronic spectral function of the Hubbard model at infinite on-site repulsion. For a square lattice with nearest-neighbor hopping we find that the ground state evolves from a paramagnetic Fermi liquid at low densities via a state with antiferromagnetic stripe order at intermediate densities to an extended Nagaoka ferromagnet at high densities. The single-particle spectral function of the Nagaoka ferromagnet exhibits a flat but rather broad band characteristic for an incoherent non-Fermi liquid. We identify two distinct ferromagnetic regimes separated by a Lifshitz transition.

summaries.title_en: Low-Altitude Fluid Antenna Network with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summaries.title_zh: 文献研究：Low-Altitude Fluid Antenna Network with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2608.27909v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Low-altitude wireless networks (LAWNs) integrate terrestrial and aerial platforms to provide ubiquitous communication, sensing, and localization services for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft. However, dynamic air-ground and air-air channels, abrupt blockages, and heterogeneous interference hinder the realization of this goal. Nevertheless, fluid antenna (FA), a cutting-edge multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) technique, overcomes these challenges by reconfiguring antenna positions to unlock additional spatial degrees-of-freedom. In this paper, towards bringing low-altitude FA networks into reality, we study the fast and high-performance FA reconfiguration for low-altitude FA networks with multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). Specifically, we present an electromagnetic digital twin (EM-DT)-assisted MARL framework. To fill the sim-to-real gap, we introduce a two-stage transfer learning framework. Our case study shows that joint FA positions and beamforming optimization can enhance the system sum-rate by 118.5%, compared to the fixed position baseline. This gain comes from the dynamic millisecond timescale reconfiguration of FA arrays and the adaptive steering of beams toward aerial users with mobility.

summaries.title_en: Magnetoelasticity in Fe/GaAs(110) films: Depth profile of magnetic anisotropy
summaries.title_zh: Fe/GaAs(110) 薄膜中的磁弹性：磁各向异性的深度分布
summaries.abstract: Author(s): Aleksandra Lindner, Rodolfo A. Gallardo, Andreas Henschke, Fabian Ganss, Javier Pablo-Navarro, Gabriel Gray, Ruslan Salikhov, Kilian Lenz, Toni Hache, Dirk Sander, Gauravkumar Patel, Sebastian Fähler, Olav Hellwig, Jürgen Fassbender, and Jürgen Lindner The authors report here the coexistence of cubic and uniaxial magnetic anisotropies in thick epitaxial bcc Fe(110)/GaAs(110) films, with the latter having a magnitude comparable to that of the former. Their interplay stabilizes an in-plane easy axis along the ⟨001⟩ directions that persists throughout the film volume for thicknesses up to 100 nm. This unconventional behavior gives rise to a depth-dependent magnetic response, with perpendicular standing spin-wave modes exhibiting distinct sensitivities to different regions of the film thickness. The study further identifies anisotropic strain as the microscopic origin of the observed in-plane uniaxial anisotropy. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 094438] Published Mon Aug 31, 2026
summaries.abstract_zh: 研究报道了厚外延 bcc Fe(110)/GaAs(110) 薄膜中立方和单轴磁各向异性的共存，二者共同稳定了沿 ⟨001⟩ 方向的面内易轴。该非常规行为导致磁响应随薄膜深度而变化，不同垂直驻波自旋波模式对膜厚不同区域的敏感性不同。研究还确定各向异性应变是面内单轴磁各向异性的微观起源。
summaries.abstract_zh_full: 作者：Aleksandra Lindner、Rodolfo A. Gallardo、Andreas Henschke、Fabian Ganss、Javier Pablo-Navarro、Gabriel Gray、Ruslan Salikhov、Kilian Lenz、Toni Hache、Dirk Sander、Gauravkumar Patel、Sebastian Fähler、Olav Hellwig、Jürgen Fassbender 和 Jürgen Lindner。作者在此报道，在厚外延 bcc Fe(110)/GaAs(110) 薄膜中，立方磁各向异性和单轴磁各向异性共存，后者的量级可与前者相当。它们之间的相互作用稳定了沿 ⟨001⟩ 方向的面内易轴，对于厚度最高达 100 nm 的薄膜，这一易轴贯穿整个膜体积而保持存在。这种非常规行为导致了随深度变化的磁响应，垂直驻波自旋波模式对薄膜厚度不同区域表现出不同的敏感性。该研究进一步确定，各向异性应变是观测到的面内单轴磁各向异性的微观起源。[《Physical Review B》114，094438]，发表于 2026 年 8 月 31 日。

summaries.title_en: Reinforcement-learning control of turbulence transition in the modified Hasegawa-Wakatani system
summaries.title_zh: 文献研究：Reinforcement-learning control of turbulence transition in the modified Hasegawa-Wakatani system
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2608.27845v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Control of plasma turbulence remains a long-standing challenge in magnetically confined fusion research. Here, we explore a reinforcement-learning (RL) approach for bidirectional control of the turbulence-zonal-flow transition in the modified Hasegawa-Wakatani system, a minimal model of electrostatic drift-wave turbulence. Within our model, a weak zonal drag damps the otherwise long-lived zonal structures, giving them a finite lifetime and restoring the drive-damping balance required for repeatable transitions within finite control episodes; meanwhile, actuation is applied through a spatially distributed Gaussian source field under a time-weighted budget constraint on actuation costs. The plasma model is then coupled to CNN-based soft actor-critic and twin-delayed deterministic policy-gradient agents through a GPU-native JAX solver that is highly optimized for fast online training. In the turbulence-suppression task, the learned budget-aware schedule achieves the lowest time-integrated turbulent flux for a given consumed budget, outperforming both constant and linearly decreasing baselines across all tested unseen initial conditions. In the inverse zonal-break task, the agent discovers an up-down antisymmetric actuation pattern that induces radial E× B convection, disrupts the zonal structure, and sustains the turbulent state. A physics-informed warm-buffer initialization facilitates this discovery, as random exploration alone struggles to locate the narrow optimal manifold within the vast action space. These results demonstrate reinforcement learning as a practical trajectory optimizer for nonlinear plasma dynamics, such as turbulence control, and highlight the importance of physics guidance in such applications.

summaries.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Reinforcement-learning control of turbulence transition in the modified Hasegawa-Wakatani system》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

summaries.title_en: Spin-Selective Spectral Flattening and Wave-Packet Dynamics in a Flux-Engineered Lieb Lattice
summaries.title_zh: 通量工程Lieb晶格中的自旋选择性谱平坦化与波包动力学
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2608.28054v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate reversible internal-state-selective wave-packet transport induced by spin-dependent Peierls phases in a two-dimensional nearest-neighbor Lieb lattice. The two conserved spin components experience effective fluxes ασ=α₀+sσαₛ, where sₚ̆ₐᵣᵣₒw,dₒwₙₐᵣᵣₒw=±1. At the working point α₀=αₛ=1/4, the spin-up and spin-down components experience αₚ̆ₐᵣᵣₒw=1/2 and αdₒwₙₐᵣᵣₒw=0, respectively. A band-resolved calculation in the q=2 magnetic unit cell shows that the spin-up spectrum contains two zero-energy flat subbands associated with the sublattice-imbalance flat-band sector, whereas the remaining four subbands retain finite bandwidths. The half-flux sector therefore fails the all-bands-flat condition and does not realize exact Aharonov--Bohm caging for a generic localized initial state. Nevertheless, real-time simulations reveal a pronounced suppression of spin-up propagation relative to the dispersive spin-down component, manifested by a smaller mean-square displacement and an enhanced finite-region retention probability over the pre-reflection time window. Reversing the state-dependent flux interchanges the slow and fast spin channels, while the dynamical contrast remains robust against moderate flux detuning. These results establish spin-dependent synthetic flux as a reversible means of controlling internal-state-resolved matter-wave transport without spin-flip processes or interactions, and provide complementary spectral and real-space criteria for distinguishing exact caging from finite-time dynamical slowing in atomic and photonic flat-band simulators.
summaries.abstract_zh: 本文研究二维最近邻Lieb晶格中由自旋依赖Peierls相位引起的、可逆的内态选择性波包输运。在特定通量工作点，自旋向上分量虽含有两个零能平带子带，但其余子带仍有有限带宽，因而不能对一般局域初态实现严格的Aharonov-Bohm笼禁。实时模拟显示，自旋向上传播显著慢于色散性自旋向下分量；反转通量可交换快慢通道，且这种动力学对比对适度失谐稳健。
summaries.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了二维最近邻Lieb晶格中由自旋依赖Peierls相位诱导的、可逆的内态选择性波包输运。两个守恒自旋分量经历的有效通量为ασ=α0+sσασ，其中s上、下=±1。在工作点α0=ασ=1/4时，自旋向上和自旋向下分量分别经历α上=1/2和α下=0。在q=2磁性元胞中进行的分辨能带计算表明，自旋向上谱包含两个与子晶格不平衡平带扇区相关的零能平坦子带，而其余四个子带仍保有有限带宽。因此，半通量扇区不满足所有能带均平坦的条件，也无法对一般局域初态实现精确的Aharonov-Bohm笼禁。尽管如此，实时模拟揭示出，相对于色散性的自旋向下分量，自旋向上传播受到显著抑制，表现为在反射前时间窗口内较小的均方位移和较高的有限区域滞留概率。反转态依赖通量会交换慢速与快速自旋通道，而动力学对比对于适度的通量失谐仍然稳健。这些结果确立了自旋依赖人工通量作为一种可逆手段，可在无自旋翻转过程或相互作用的条件下控制按内态分辨的物质波输运，并为在原子和光子平带模拟器中区分精确笼禁与有限时间动力学减速提供了互补的谱学和实空间判据。

summaries.title_en: Orbital-Selective Coexistence of Interlayer Spin-Singlet Formation and SDW Order with Anomalous Spin Reconfiguration in Bilayer Nickelate La₃Ni₂O₇ Revealed by ¹⁷O-NMR
summaries.title_zh: 通过17O核磁共振揭示双层镍酸盐La3Ni2O7中层间自旋单态形成与SDW有序的轨道选择性共存及异常自旋重构
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2608.27917v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The spin structure of the spin density wave (SDW) order in the bilayer nickelate La₃Ni₂O₇ has been investigated using site-selective ¹⁷O-NMR measurements on the inner apical O(1), outer apical O(2), and planar O(3,4) sites. Below Tₘ̊ SDW (= 150 K), the peak of all planar O(3,4) sites significantly broadens due to the emergence of a finite internal magnetic field, whereas O(2) sites remain with no (or a negligibly small) internal field. These results are consistent with commensurate SDW order with a single spin-spinless (or large-tiny spin) stripe. As for the O(1) sites that bridge the NiO₂ planes, the internal field is nearly canceled below Tₘ̊ SDW, indicating an antiparallel spin configuration between adjacent planes. However, below T_A (sim 115 K), the spectrum of the O(1) site disappears even though the in-plane SDW order remains robust, implying that the antiparallel spin configuration through the Ni--O(1)--Ni bond is not particularly stable below Tₘ̊ A, despite the expected strong interlayer spin coupling between the NiO₂ planes. Above all, we emphasize that the local spin susceptibility is extremely small at the O(2) site that has a strong covalency with the d₃z^₂₋ᵣ^₂ orbital, indicating a well-developed interlayer spin-singlet formation in the Ni-d₃z^₂₋ᵣ^₂ orbitals bridging the NiO₂ planes. These findings shed new light on the interlayer spin-singlet formation and the anomalous spin reconfiguration through the Ni--O(1)--Ni bonding orbitals connecting the NiO₂ planes, which characterize the orbital-selective nature of the bilayer nickelate La₃Ni₂O₇.
summaries.abstract_zh: 研究利用位点选择性17O核磁共振考察双层镍酸盐La3Ni2O7中自旋密度波（SDW）有序的自旋结构。结果表明，面内氧位点的内磁场支持具有单条无自旋或微弱自旋条纹的公度SDW有序，而连接两层NiO2平面的内顶位氧显示相邻平面自旋反平行，但该构型在约115 K以下发生异常重构。外顶位氧极低的局域自旋磁化率表明，跨层Ni-d3z2-r2轨道中已形成发达的层间自旋单态。
summaries.abstract_zh_full: 研究采用对内顶位O(1)、外顶位O(2)和面内O(3,4)位点进行选择性17O核磁共振测量，考察了双层镍酸盐La3Ni2O7中自旋密度波（SDW）有序的自旋结构。在TSDW=150 K以下，所有面内O(3,4)位点的谱峰均因有限内部磁场的出现而显著展宽，而O(2)位点则没有内部磁场，或仅存在可忽略不计的内部磁场。这些结果与具有单条无自旋（或大-小自旋）条纹的公度SDW有序相一致。对于连接NiO2平面的O(1)位点，其内部磁场在TSDW以下几乎完全抵消，表明相邻平面之间存在反平行自旋构型。然而，在TA（约115 K）以下，尽管面内SDW有序仍然稳健，O(1)位点的谱线却消失了，这意味着尽管预期NiO2平面之间存在很强的层间自旋耦合，经由Ni-O(1)-Ni键的反平行自旋构型在TA以下并不特别稳定。尤为重要的是，我们强调，与d3z2-r2轨道具有强共价性的O(2)位点处局域自旋磁化率极低，这表明连接NiO2平面的Ni-d3z2-r2轨道中形成了充分发展的层间自旋单态。这些发现为理解层间自旋单态形成，以及通过连接NiO2平面的Ni-O(1)-Ni成键轨道发生的异常自旋重构提供了新视角；这些现象表征了双层镍酸盐La3Ni2O7的轨道选择性本质。
summaries.summary: 研究利用位点选择性17O核磁共振考察双层镍酸盐La3Ni2O7中自旋密度波（SDW）有序的自旋结构。结果表明，面内氧位点的内磁场支持具有单条无自旋或微弱自旋条纹的公度SDW有序，而连接两层NiO2平面的内顶位氧显示相邻平面自旋反平行，但该构型在约115 K以下发生异常重构。外顶位氧极低的局域自旋磁化率表明，跨层Ni-d3z2-r2轨道中已形成发达的层间自旋单态。

summaries.title_en: Landau theory of quenched criticality in linear in-context learning
summaries.title_zh: 线性上下文学习中淬火临界性的朗道理论
summaries.abstract: arXiv:2608.28059v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) allows a pretrained model to infer a new task from examples supplied in its prompt without updating its parameters. In linear models of ICL, the prediction error develops a double-descent singularity when the number of pretraining samples becomes comparable to the number of learnable parameters. We formulate this interpolation singularity as a critical phenomenon of a quenched disordered system. By comparing annealed and quenched descriptions of the same linear ICL model, we identify the connected sample-to-sample fluctuations of the learned parameters as the microscopic origin of the singular error. A Landau potential is constructed by integrating the cavity self-consistency equation for the renormalized ridge parameter ξ. The role of (magnetization) order parameter is played by ξ, while the bare ridge parameter łambda becomes its conjugate magnetic field. The normalized sample complexity τ acts as a temperature and the double-descent singularity occurs at the critical temperature τ_c =1. The Landau susceptibility is precisely the quantity that diverges in the fluctuation contribution to the prediction error. The order parameter is closely related to the fraction of zero eigenvalues of the empirical relaxation matrix in the ridgeless limit, which define flat directions in the learning dynamics. The Landau theory is generically cubic in the order parameter with critical exponents (βₘ̊ cᵣ,δₘ̊ cᵣ,γₘ̊ cᵣ)=(1,2,1). In the large-context regime, there appears a pseudogap-like regime characterized by suppressed order parameter. Predictions of the Landau theory are independently confirmed from numerical solutions of the original learning problem with good quantitative agreement. Our results pave the way for solid statistical-physics understanding of the interpolation criticality in linear in-context learning.
summaries.abstract_zh: 线性上下文学习中，当预训练样本数接近可学习参数数目时，预测误差会出现双降奇异性。本文将该插值奇异性表述为淬火无序系统的临界现象，并将学习参数的样本间连通涨落确定为奇异误差的微观来源。由重整化岭参数构造的朗道理论给出临界点τc=1、临界指数(βcr,δcr,γcr)=(1,2,1)，并得到原始学习问题数值解的验证。
summaries.abstract_zh_full: 上下文学习（ICL）使预训练模型能够从提示词中给出的示例推断新任务，而无需更新其参数。在ICL的线性模型中，当预训练样本数与可学习参数数目相当时，预测误差会出现双降奇异性。我们将这种插值奇异性表述为淬火无序系统的临界现象。通过比较同一线性ICL模型的退火描述和淬火描述，我们识别出学习参数的样本间连通涨落是奇异误差的微观起源。通过积分重整化岭参数ξ的腔体自洽方程，构造了一个朗道势。序参量，即类似于磁化强度的量，由ξ承担，而裸岭参数λ成为其共轭磁场。归一化样本复杂度τ充当温度，双降奇异性发生在临界温度τc=1。朗道磁化率恰好就是在预测误差涨落贡献中发散的量。在无岭极限下，序参量与经验弛豫矩阵零本征值所占比例密切相关，而这些零本征值定义了学习动力学中的平坦方向。该朗道理论在序参量中一般为三次形式，其临界指数为(βcr,δcr,γcr)=(1,2,1)。在大上下文区间内，出现了一个以序参量受抑制为特征的赝能隙式区域。朗道理论的预测通过原始学习问题数值解得到了独立确认，并具有良好的定量一致性。我们的结果为扎实地从统计物理学角度理解线性上下文学习中的插值临界性开辟了道路。

summaries.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
